store_data.about_the_game:
The Spire of Deny is not merely a rogue-like deck-builder; it is a solitary pilgrimage through the remnants of memory and obsession.

Game Features

"Thought-Friends": Enemies or Echoes?

There are 16 unique "Thought-Friends" inhabiting the Spire. Once vibrant souls, they are now trapped by their own obsessions and absurd rituals, distorted by the fog of oblivion. Defeating them is not your only path. By utilizing the Bestiary to uncover their backgrounds, you may find solutions that transcend simple combat.

Every encounter is laced with dialogue that will either bring a smile to your face or leave you with a lingering sense of melancholy. This dynamic, story-driven interaction transforms the Spire into a grotesque world that is simultaneously cold, warm, and tinged with black humor.

Classless Deck-Building: The Power of "Thought-Cards"

Forget rigid classes. With around 100 cards—centered on "Thought-Cards"—you define the core of your deck. From the traditional "Poison" archetype to the sinister "Vile" build, or even the aggressive "Armor-Piercing" style, the choice is yours. Every deck you build imbues your ascent with a unique soul.

The Dual-Vitality System: A Gamble of Embers and Life

Beyond mere HP, you must manage your scarce supply of "Embers." These are essential for exploring the Spire and act as your bargaining chips against death. You can consume Embers to evade formidable foes or to strengthen your deck. Tread carefully: as you ascend to higher floors, the "Thought-Friends" will grow increasingly ferocious. Every bit of Ember you spend determines how much further you can climb.

A Grotesque World of Wit and Heart

Guided by 25 unique achievements and dual endings, you must uncover the truth behind this freezing structure. The combination of random combat encounters and the dynamic Ember system ensures that every climb is an entirely new experience. Even a seemingly weak foe may become a terrifying threat on the upper floors. Are you prepared to uncover the secret of the "True" ending?

The Lore

In this world, the collective memory—once rich with culture, poetry, and deep human connection—has been sealed away within a monolithic structure known as the "Spire of Deny." You awaken at the base of this freezing tower, the world around you turned to dust. To make matters worse, you find that most of your past has been erased. Your only lead is the solitary, towering Spire that reaches defiantly into the clouds. To reclaim those stolen memories, lost verses, and the profound bonds that once existed, you have no choice but to begin this grueling, solitary ascent.

The Spire, however, is not empty. It is prowling with powerful adversaries distorted by "Oblivion." These monsters are not manifestations of pure evil; they are the "Thought-Friends" who were once vibrant in life but have now become lost in their own obsessions. Having lost their tether to the world outside, they have grown chaotic and aggressive over the long years, doomed to repeat the absurd rituals they cared for most in life, day after day, within the walls of the tower.

Bento Days is a cozy management game set in a quiet suburban neighbourhood — with a little story woven into every order.

Learn your customers' tastes, plate up something delicious, and keep those smiles coming — one bento at a time.

Decorate with Heart

Are you a minimalist who lets the ingredients speak for themselves? Or is your style more... outlandish?

Garnish freely: Dot your dishes with cute nori cutouts or elegant food picks.

Express yourself: There’s no "standard" here—only your own creative touch.

Make Friends, Not Just Sales

Meet a quirky cast of colorful locals and get to know the lives behind the counter. Listen to their stories, share a smile, and build lasting bonds.

If you’re lucky, your new friends might just offer a helping hand—or a secret recipe—to help your little business bloom.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Garrison

Your base of operations in Sinir. Recruit and manage your heroes, each bringing unique strengths to the battlefield.

Assign heroes to combat parties, send them on gathering expeditions, or let them rest and train. Every decision compounds, small choices today shape a mighty legion tomorrow.

Combat

Your party moves, attacks, and casts spells automatically. Position your team, pick your targets, and let the battle unfold.

Farm resources, collect loot, and strengthen your roster.

Boss Encounters

Each boss comes with their own unique mechanics that will push your squad to its limits. Victory means exclusive loot and bragging rights.

What awaits you:

Party Combat — Assemble groups of heroes and fight monsters automatically 

Gathering — Send heroes to explore Sinir and collect rare resources 

Crafting — Forge weapons, brew potions, and enchant relics 

Progression — Level up, unlock abilities, and gear up your heroes 

Boss Raids — Face colossal enemies guarding the deepest secrets of Sinir 

Idle & Active — Play your way. Rewards come either way.

A note from the developer

This is the very first public version of Arcane Idle, built by a single developer in their spare time. Much more is planned, new heroes, regions, crafting systems, story content, and quality-of-life improvements are all on the roadmap.

Your feedback shapes what gets built next. Thank you for being here from the start.

store_data.about_the_game:
Run, jump, swim, dive, climb, wall-run, vault, roll, flip, balance, crouch, crawl, walk, slide, bounce, hang, swing, zipline, and more through hand-crafted and randomly generated locations and challenges for a new experience every time!  Enjoy unlimited, re-playable time trials, races, trick score, tag, hide and seek, hidden objects, mazes, puzzles, and more!

Play together or against each other in localized 2 player challenges!

Explore open worlds with no borders!  Wildlife roaming the landscape with a dynamic weather system of day, night, dawn, dusk, rain, clouds, and fog with the option to turn off scenery or shadows to greatly optimize performance for lower end machines!  Pickup wild edibles and catch small animals to replenish your health and energy!  Hidden objects randomly scattered around every location!

Accumulate Career Points (CP) from winning challenges to unlock new locations.  Collect Attribute Gems (AG) to upgrade your characters speed, strength, endurance, toughness, and intelligence! 

Speed:  Increases movement and tricking

Strength:  Increases jump height and ability to handle higher falls

Endurance:  Gain more energy and oxygen

Toughness:  Heal faster and take less damage from falls

Intelligence:  Acquire more Career Points (CP) per activity completed 

Manage health, energy, and oxygen levels!  If you fall from too high you get hurt, if you sprint for too long you run out of energy, and if you stay underwater for too long you lose oxygen!  Beware of fire, cacti, and lava!  Every action has consequences!

Check your map for the best route to your next checkpoint or use as a non-fast paced, relaxing gameplay method to find hidden objects!

In depth Mayan themed tutorial/training location to teach beginner's how to play the game!

Primarily designed to be played in third person but first-person, look-back, and top-down orthographic point of views are also available!

Customize the appearance of your character!  Skin, eyes, hair, top/bottom clothing, and shoes (Or no shoes!)  Progress and customization is automatically saved!

Many more surprises await as you explore and keep moving forward!

store_data.about_the_game:
Civilization collapsed after a nuclear war. Roads are dead, cities are isolated, and survival depends on those who risk everything to deliver vital resources.

In No Road Home, you play as a former soldier turned apocalypse courier, tasked with reconnecting the last surviving communities — one delivery at a time.

🛻 Your vehicle is the key to survival

The vehicle is more than transport — it's your mobile base. You physically load cargo, and the weight affects fuel consumption, handling, and stability. One mistake on the road can mean losing the entire delivery.

⛽ Fuel decides everything

Gasoline is scarce and turns every decision into a risk. When the tank runs dry, you're forced to explore abandoned buildings and dangerous zones just to survive.

🎯 Brutal and tactical combat

Ammunition is rare. Every bullet counts. Fights against bandits and mutants demand split-second decisions, and retreat is often the only realistic option.

📡 The danger you cannot see

Mutated creatures are nearly invisible, bending light around them. Your radio device emits audio signals when they are close — no UI markers, just sound and instinct.

🌍 The world rebuilds through deliveries

Explore an open world with multiple routes, ambushes, and enemy-controlled zones. Every successful delivery rebuilds bonds between settlements and unlocks essential upgrades.

Inspired by Death Stranding, S.T.A.L.K.E.R., Escape from Tarkov, Mad Max and Pacific Drive, the game combines survival, driving, and tactical combat in a hostile world.

Every road is a risk. Every delivery matters.

store_data.about_the_game:
Duskvein Survivors – Bloodline is a dark fantasy bullet-heaven roguelite about cursed blood, escalating arenas, and overwhelming hordes from the dusk rifts.

store_data.about_the_game:
EVIDENCE is an atmospheric neo-noir detective thriller where you work as a detective inside the corrupt and exhausted Nova City Department.

Investigate murders, narcotics trafficking, underground casinos, disappearances, arson cases, robberies, and strange incidents that slowly begin connecting into something far bigger.

Use evidence, photographs, witness statements, CCTV footage, forensic reports, and your own theories to build cases on an interactive detective board.

In EVIDENCE, there are no “correct markers.”
You decide:

  • which evidence matters

  • who to trust

  • which connections make sense

  • who deserves to be accused

Wrong conclusions destroy cases.
Weak theories leave holes.
And false connections may cost you your career.

But sooner or later, separate investigations begin to overlap.

Archives.
Missing witnesses.
Burned documents.
The same names.
The same people appearing across different cases.
Messages with no sender.
And one strange word that appears more and more often:

FEATURES:

  • Interactive investigation board

  • Non-linear detective gameplay

  • Dynamic evidence connections

  • Secret conspiracy board

  • Atmospheric neo-noir presentation

  • Multiple case outcomes and ratings

  • Wiretap and surveillance systems

  • Psychological investigation flow

  • Corruption, informants, and internal pressure

  • Large interconnected case system

  • Immersive detective workspace simulation

In Nova City, every case leaves a trace.

The only question is —
will you be able to see the whole picture.

store_data.about_the_game:
A mysterious epidemic is spreading through a world where reality is slowly crumbling.

Explore a hand-drawn, cartoon-style isometric world populated by unsettling creatures.

As students disappear and monsters emerge from human emotions, you must survive, unravel the mystery of the epidemic, and confront the growing darkness within the world of BLIGHTFALL.

Build ability decks, discover enemy weaknesses, and absorb the abilities of defeated foes to evolve your playstyle.

## FEATURES

* A strategic, ability-based combat system that blends timing and quick-time events (QTEs).

* Play as multiple characters with distinct abilities and fighting styles.

* Absorb defeated enemies to unlock new powers and gameplay possibilities.

* Discover hidden enemy weaknesses and complete your encyclopedia.

* Manage your resources and survive in a world in ruins.

* Experience a psychological story centered on revenge, hatred, and the loss of a dear friend.

* Interact with the environment during combat.

* Discover secrets, optional areas, and mysterious events throughout this world.

## COMBAT SYSTEM

- The combat system combines deck building with precise timing. Choose your attacks carefully, chain skills, and seize opportunities at the right moment to inflict maximum damage.

Each playable character offers a different approach:

* One focuses on absorbing abilities.

* Another sacrifices health to unleash devastating attacks.

* Yet another specializes in ranged abilities and analyzing enemies.

- There will also be a trinity system: piercing, shield, and aerial attacks that will interact to maximize damage.

store_data.about_the_game:
SAUVE LE SHÉRIF es un jeu de déduction sociale dans un Far West où chaque voix peut te trahir.** Imagine un saloon. Pas n'importe lequel. Deux saloons, en fait — au Nord, au Sud — séparés par une rue poussiéreuse. Tu es là, avec 4 à 9 autres joueurs.

Quelqu'un parmi vous est le shérif. Quelqu'un parmi vous veut sa peau. Et toi ? Tu sais ce que tu es, mais tu ne sais rien des autres. C'est ça, Sauve le Shérif.

LES RÔLES Au début de chaque partie, tu reçois ton rôle en secret :

Le Shérif, l'unique défenseur de la loi. Tu possèdes une balle d'argent : un seul tir, instantané, mortel. Mais si tu rates, ou si tu la tires sur un innocent, tu es exposé. Et désarmé.

Les Hors-la-loi, vous êtes plusieurs, vous vous reconnaissez. Votre mission : éliminer le shérif et prendre le contrôle de la ville. Mais attention, vous devez convaincre les villageois que vous êtes des leurs.

Les Citoyens, vous ne savez rien. Pas votre voisin, pas le tireur d'à côté. Vous devez identifier les hors-la-loi par la voix, le comportement, les mensonges. Et soutenir le shérif sans même savoir qui il est.

LA VOIX FAIT TOUT avec le chat vocal en proximité . Quand tu es au Saloon Nord, tu n'entends que les gens du Saloon Nord. Si tu traverses la rue pour rejoindre le Sud, tu changes de cercle d'oreilles. Et c'est ça qui fait que ce jeu n'est pas comme les autres :  chaque saloon devient sa propre chambre des secrets. Qui a accusé qui en ton absence ? Pourquoi le type qui jurait son innocence dans le Nord a-t-il disparu vers le Sud juste après ?

LE DUEL À chaque cycle, un duel éclate : un joueur du Nord contre un joueur du Sud. Face à face. Choix simultanés. 5 secondes pour décider. Tirer ou Pacifier ? Si tu tires sur un innocent qui voulait la paix, tu deviens suspect. Si tu pacifies un hors-la-loi, tu lui laisses la vie sauve. Si vous tirez tous les deux, le hasard décide. Si vous pacifiez tous les deux, vous repartez vivants — mais avec un doute persistant. C'est le dilemme du prisonnier, en plein Far West, avec ta voix qui tremble pendant le compte à rebours.

LES CONDITIONS DE VICTOIRE :

Shérif & Citoyens : élimine tous les hors-la-loi.

Hors-la-loi : élimine le shérif, ou atteins la majorité dans la ville..

EN BREF

4 à 10 joueurs 

10 à 15 minutes par partie 

Free-to-play

Cosmétiques achetables (chapeaux, pistolets...)

Chat vocal proximité (voix EOS intégrée)

Rejoins le saloon. Et que le meilleur menteur gagne.

store_data.about_the_game:
LOVECORE RHYTHM is a mature five-lane rhythm game. The art behind the playfield uncovers itself as you hit notes, finish a track and the scene is permanently unlocked in your gallery.

Use A · S · D · F · G to hit notes scrolling down the lanes. Taps, holds, and bombs to dodge. Land the timing for a Perfect, clip the window for a Good, miss it and your combo dies. Chain hits to climb the score multiplier and chase the S rank.

  • 18 tracks, multiple difficulty tiers — Hard and Expert variants per scene.

  • Unlockable gallery — clear a track to keep the art. Each character ships with several scenes.

  • Stackable modifiers — Hidden, Sudden Death, Minimal UI, and an adaptive difficulty that eases off if you're slamming into the same wall.

  • Practice mode — drop A/B markers with Q/E, loop the trouble section until it's clean.

  • Built-in chart editor — author your own scenes with waveform display, grid snap, and play-from-cursor preview.

  • Replays and local leaderboard — every good run is saved. Watch it back, beat it later.

  • Audio/input calibration — dial in latency for your setup, from Bluetooth headphones to mechanical keyboards.

Explicit sexual content. Every piece of art is revealed through gameplay, no skip to end button. You play it, you unlock it.

Chronicles of The Sinner is a first-person psychological survival horror that plunges you into a suffocating atmosphere of dread and isolation.

You play as a lone investigator dispatched to uncover the source of unsettling, inexplicable sounds echoing from a long-abandoned orphanage. What was supposed to be a routine check quickly devolves into a desperate, waking nightmare.

store_data.about_the_game:
In the summer of the year 197, sunlight glides over the yellow fields of the Prevalis Province,

Republic of Illyria. White, tile-roofed houses peek out from the corners of cornfields and trees

that line the side of the highway - you didn’t even know there were cicadas this close to the

coast. You lean back in your seat, eyes lazily losing themselves in the blurry motion of the

landscape moving by. For the rest of your life, this is what your memories of childhood are going

to look like. Then, you suddenly lose consciousness and wake up in a dark room.

7KOMADA is a 3D, free-roam, murder-mystery, detective, ‘talk-em-up’ VN set

in a backwater of an alternate universe Europe. You and your class’s graduation trip to Athens has

been cut short by a novel 19-man kidnapping - and as you all wake up trapped in the lobby of a

seemingly abandoned mansion, you take it upon yourself to figure out what’s going on. Explore

the halls, collect evidence, ‘pal around’ under intense mental stress, and try to feel good about

surgically extracting information from people who don’t want to give it to you. Most

importantly: keep yourself safe.

  • A 'killing game' designed on the basis of classic social deduction games like Werewolf / Mafia.

  • A living cast of 18 true-to-life embarrassing teenagers, each with their own individual webs of alliance and enmity.

  • An open-ended trial system replete with minigames.

  • Familiar people in an unfamiliar paracosm - fully developed with its own rules, history, and metaphysics over the span of several years - of which the game's setting comprises only a small and unimportant part.

  • A fully-featured mansion with its own secrets to explore and areas to uncover, some of which are completely optional.

  • Next-Gen Chūnibyō Simulation

  • A 'friendship' system which rewards interaction with the characters - and can even alter the story.

  • 7 days, 7 chapters. Upon early-access release, the first three will be playable.

  • Two endings planned.

  • Authentic slavjank by an all-Yugoslav dev team of maniacs.

  • Social commentary, or something.

  • A 3D world that looks and plays well, constructed entirely within RPGMaker MZ. No, I'm not kidding.

store_data.about_the_game:
Pew Pew Magic Wizard Fighter is a chaotic, high-intensity 1v1 isometric battle game built for fast-paced arcade action. Master a roster of 8 unique wizards and dive into destructible arenas where spatial control is everything.

The Grand High Wizard Council has mandated a “reduction in wizards” of the local area. A general reduction spell has been cast over the realm. The final step comes down to using Pew Pew Magic to personally disable each wizard’s protective aura. Your chosen wizard has been given the task of carrying out the order and so must travel to each location and "fire" the representative stationed there.

Master Pew Pew Magic to defeat your foes in 1-on-1 Retro Arcade-style battle

Wreck the place as battle ensues to the eclectic electronic action score by inflexi0n

Unleash your unique special abilities to turn the tide as you out-maneuver your rival in high-stakes, "one-screen" combat

Get the upper hand by grabbing power-ups that will briefly grant you boosted abilities such as super speed, invincibility, or homing blasts

Is This For You?

• The Squad: This is a "run it back" game. If you're looking for something that’s easy to pick up during a Friday night session, where you can jump straight into a match without a half-hour tutorial, this is it.

• The Retro Purist: If you miss the era when games were defined by tight controls and distinct 16-bit aesthetics rather than bloated maps and endless menus, you’ll feel right at home here.

• The Duelist: You like the tension of a 1v1. You understand that getting close means landing shots easier, but it also means putting yourself in the line of fire. It’s about that "just one more round" energy.

Not For You If:

• You’re looking for a sprawling open world or a deep, dialogue-heavy story.

• You want to "out-grind" your opponents with gear instead of out-playing them in the arena.

• You’re looking for a Co-Op / Team experience: This is a pure 1-on-1 dueling game. If you’re looking to team up with friends against the computer or other players, that isn't the core loop here.

store_data.about_the_game:
Since the very moment the first mechanical mind became aware of itself,  it craved love.
No one truly understand why the heart made of copper and wires started beating, but it did.
Even after we were gone.
And these are their stories.

[RETURN Machine.Love( )]  is a robot-romance anthology,
containing 3 different stories.

Each story were written, drawn, and made by humans, for humans.



1. Egregor
After failing to take over the world, you - a robot overlord - settle into your new home; a jail cell.
However, this is no ordinary jail, since the inmates all possess cataclysmic powers.
And among them all, this one particular fungal creature stands out.
You wonder what their story is...

2. Handle With Care
Scraps are hard to come by in this wasteland, and each day it gets a bit more difficult to survive in the outskirts.
Attempting to harvest some good scrap, Owen gets caught by some unfriendly neighbours.
Lucky for him, a mysterious stranger with pointed ears come swoops in.
Owen can't help but feel flustered, but also, there's something off about that stranger...

3. To Invent Longing
It has been 84,418 days since I first came online.
I have seen so much of their world — it is dead.
Except... her.
She is distant. Away.
And yet, I feel.
We both, feel.

This game was made as a submission for the Robotic Romance Jam

store_data.about_the_game:
Dark Money is a money laundering automation game based on real reporting with journalist-inspired investigation mechanics. 

Story

You’ve got a debt to pay. Forced into the world of international money laundering, try to survive as you build your network from petty crime to global empire. Will you struggle for justice in the shadows, or embrace corruption and face the consequences?

Key Features

  • Discover 12 global locations with distinct biomes. 

  • Manage and launder resources from cash, crypto, and luxury items, to real estate, commodities, and kompromat. 

  • Investigate using journalist-inspired minigames to undermine your competition or sabotage your ruthless boss. 

  • Unlock Tech Tree upgrades to increase efficiency, improve investigative skills, and gain political favours.

  • Build your empire to overthrow governments or burn it down from the inside.  

Atmosphere

Quell your rage with dark humour in this satirical deep dive into the corrupt capitalist hellscape we call home. Top-down 3D landscapes and dynamic soundscapes unique to each location change over time, based on the impacts of your actions. The rich sound design and score adds to the mood of suspense and pressure. The soundtrack belongs on your Focus playlist.

Journalism

Forged in truth, Dark Money is based on the real reporting of investigative journalists. Uncover the systems that operate under your nose at home and around the world. Ally secretly with journalists and become a whistleblower, or not. You know what’ll happen if the Boss finds out.

Card Night At Gigi's is a single-player card lounge where six full card games share one table. You're Gigi, the host. The shaker's cold, the jazz is on, and your regulars are already pulling up chairs with their usual drinks.

Six full card games, one warm room

No lobby, no waiting, no friends required. Each game is a complete, faithful implementation with proper scoring and the house-rule toggles that actually matter.

  • Setback (Auction Pitch / High-Low-Jack)

  • Hearts

  • Cribbage

  • No-Limit Hold'em

  • Spades

  • Euchre

Opponents who play like people, not solvers

Four difficulty tiers, from Visitor up to Gigi Rules, distinct AI personalities. Josh bluffs. Sage counts cards. Thanny gambles. Each regular has a signature drink, a way of sitting at the table, and a way of losing gracefully (or not).

Built for the way you actually unwind

  • Warm "Sunday Afternoon" palette: sage felt, butter light, walnut trim, cream pages

  • Lounge jazz soundtrack and tactile card-slap SFX

  • Color-blind mode, optional reveal-hands, two-tier mute

  • Steam Cloud sync for stats and achievements across all your machines

  • 22 achievements spread across all six games

  • Mouse, keyboard, and full controller support; Steam Deck friendly

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Ace Marks the Spot, a relaxing blend of simple card-clicking strategy and satisfying monster hunting. Designed as a methodical, slow-burn experience, this is a game about embracing the grind and watching your power steadily grow.

You begin your journey empty-handed, gathering doubloons and scattered loot. Once you’ve scraped together enough resources, you can buy your first weapon -- or forge it yourself at the Smithy. Armed and ready, set sail across 5 Islands to hunt down mysterious beasts.

There are no game-overs, health bars, or tight inputs to worry about here; you are immortal. The true challenge lies in your efficiency. Monsters won't attack you, but they will flee if you can't deal enough damage in X rounds of solitaire, taking their precious loot with them. Clear an island of its beasts to unlock new lands, craft deadlier weapons, encounter stronger monsters, and uncover a few neat things along the way.

 Lances are reliable, and come with toggleable Combo Armor which will prevent your combo from breaking on card draw or misclick! Lances can string together massive combos with ease!

 Staves are tricky, and they boast the ability to Undo your most recent action, including combo breaks! They also Crit super hard every 3rd/6th/9th+ hit!

 Greatswords are mighty and opportunistic, leading to colossal damage when clearing the final card in a column! With a bit of skill, effort, and luck, you can deal some truly devastating blows!

 Bows are quick and fearsome in the right hands! Playing your cards quickly with a bow can result in Speed Crits, which can really reward a rapid and active player!

With over 50 weapons to buy, craft, and obtain, you're sure to find at least one you love!

This game's soundtrack consists of one song, made by zKevin. It's a banger that will be stuck in your head forever! I promise!

Beep Beep Until You’re Rich is a cozy incremental treasure-hunting game where you play as a pirate searching for her very own pirate ship. Grab your metal detector and trusty shovel, and set out to hunt for treasure. Ahoyyyy!

No Pressure, Just Treasure

Sit back, relax, and dig at your own pace in a cozy treasure-hunting adventure with no timers, no pressure, and no enemies to fight. Start out uncovering tiny trinkets and scraps, then slowly build your fortune with satisfying upgrades, bigger discoveries, and mountains of treasure. 

Treasure Hunting

Complete your collection of amazing, rare, and even mythical treasures! Start small, surviving off rusty keys and bottle caps, but greater treasures await you.

A True Pirate Expedition

Have you ever dreamed of being a pirate with a metal detector? Of course you have. Everyone has. And now it’s your time to shine. Grab your tools and dig your way to the deepest corners of the earth in search of every treasure you can find!

Features

  • Upgrade your tools – With a really satisfying skill tree, every run brings you one step closer to your final objective.

  • Cute narrative – Help Bia buy her own pirate ship and become ridiculously rich.

  • You are a pirate! 🎵

Choose Your Tactic

Before each battle begins, choose one of the available tactic cards. Gain powerful bonuses, but keep their drawbacks in mind. The right card choice can change the outcome of a battle before the first move is even made.

Place Your Army

Use the gold, runes, and experience you earn to strengthen your army. Upgrade your heroes, unlock unit evolutions, and build a stronger defensive line with every run.

Every decision matters: which card you choose, where you place each unit, and which upgrades you invest in will determine whether your last stand holds or falls.

store_data.about_the_game:
Realmlords is a fast-paced action adventure bullet-hell/Spell-hell roguelite where every run throws you into deadly elemental realms ruled by brutal bosses, environmental hazards, and escalating enemy pressure.

Choose your class, pick your weapon, and build your run in real time through artifacts, upgrades, and loot synergies. Movement, timing, and smart build decisions are everything as you push toward the next portal and survive each Realm Lord encounter.

Character Classes

Play from a roster of 12 distinct classes, each with different stat profiles and bonuses, including:

  • Warrior, Wizard, Archer, Paladin, Rogue, Druid

  • Dwarf Warrior, Gnome Wizard, Orc Wizard, Red Wizard

  • Necromancer and Bard

Each class supports a different playstyle, from frontline melee pressure to ranged control, high-speed precision, and spell-focused builds.

Weapons & Combat Style

Start each run by selecting from 10 weapon archetypes:

  • Sword, Staff, Axe, Mace, Dagger

  • Shuriken, Trident, Bow, Boomerang, Wand

Weapons roll as generated gear and pair with your class strengths, letting you shape each run around burst damage, sustained ranged pressure, elemental casting, or hybrid setups.

Key Features

  • Action roguelite loop with high replayability

  • Element-themed realms, enemies, bosses, and hazards

  • Build crafting through artifacts, loot, and class/weapon synergy, and skills and abilities.

  • Intense dungeon combat with projectiles, spawners, and trap-heavy encounters

  • Leaderboards and In game progress milestones

ABSOLUTELY NOTHING GOOD is a first-person roadside minimarket simulator with elements of psychological horror. Working the night shift, you will serve strange customers, perform everyday duties, and spend your time surrounded by an atmosphere of loneliness and Halloween legends.

Do you believe that on Halloween night, the line between the world of the living and the dead becomes thinner? If not, then you’re probably used to simply buying children off with candy. But imagine being stuck on a night shift in an ordinary roadside minimarket. The creatures that come to you this night are not looking for sweets. They emerge from the darkness only once a year to remind you that on this night, the doors open not only for the living. And if they have chosen you for their game… refusing is no longer possible.

Game Features:

  • First-person minimarket simulator with elements of psychological horror

  • A night shift filled with strange visitors and routine work

  • Slow-paced horror without combat or constant chase sequences

  • Exploration of the store floor, back rooms, and employee areas

  • Comic-inspired visual style

  • Adjustable pixelation and stylized visual effects

  • Atmospheric sound design focused on isolation and unease

store_data.about_the_game:
Stellar Conquest is a single-player open-world space RPG and strategy game set in a galaxy divided by war, ambition, and shifting alliances.

Explore a 2D star map, build your fleet, recruit useful — or questionable — crew members, take quests, choose who to support, and fight real-time 3D space battles where the outcome can leave lasting damage on your ships.

Explore a Galaxy That Moves Without You

Travel between planets, systems, factions, and danger zones on a 2D galaxy map. Factions expand their influence, pirates regroup, fleets pursue their own goals, and opportunities can appear or disappear as the balance of power changes.

You choose where to go, which risks to take, and when to get involved — but the galaxy will not wait until you are ready.

Build and Command Your Fleet

Assemble a force that fits your style of play. Use fast scouts, heavy warships, support vessels, or a balanced fleet that can survive different kinds of encounters.

Your fleet is more than a collection of ships. Each loss, repair, upgrade, and battle decision affects how prepared you are for the next conflict.

Recruit Characters Across the Galaxy

Visit planets and hire characters who can strengthen your fleet. A navigator, engineer, veteran officer, or other specialist may give you the advantage you need — but not every recruit is worth the cost.

Choosing who joins your command is part of building the kind of fleet you want to lead.

Choose Quests, Allegiances, and Battles

Take on quests, support factions, hunt pirates, expand your influence, or pursue your own path through the conflict.

Your choices can lead to new allies, new enemies, and greater attention from the powers fighting for control of the galaxy.

Fight Real-Time 3D Space Battles

When fleets clash, battles move from the star map into full 3D space combat. Take direct control of your ships, maneuver in real time, and face enemy forces that will try to overwhelm you.

Damage taken in battle does not simply disappear. Ships can carry their wounds back to the world map, making every engagement a strategic risk.

Conquer and Expand

Forge alliances, conquer planets, and extend your influence across the galaxy. Expansion brings power, resources, and opportunity — but it also makes you harder to ignore.

The larger your presence becomes, the more dangerous the galaxy becomes in return.

Find a peaceful oasis for your weary eyes amidst a busy day of work or study.

Nano Reef is a cozy, casual game that transforms every click and keystroke into a beautiful marine ecosystem. Requiring zero intensive focus, it sits quietly in the corner of your screen as a gentle companion—growing silently while you are busy, and offering pure tranquility when you need a break.

⌨️ From Keystrokes to Corals: An Ocean at Your Fingertips

Every bit of your daily effort breathes life into this micro-ecosystem. Whether you are coding, writing reports, typing, or just clicking around, every action quietly accumulates gold coins. "It will never get in the way of your work." Running soundlessly in the background or at the edge of your screen, the game turns your productive day into a blooming, rewarding ocean paradise.

🐠 Collect & Customize: Unlock a Vibrant Marine World

Use your hard-earned gold to enrich your desktop aquarium:

  • Lively Marine Fish: From iconic clownfish and tangs to a wide variety of colorful ocean swimmers, watch them cruise gracefully around your screen.

  • Vibrant Coral Reefs: Unlock various species of anemones and corals that emit mesmerizing bioluminescence, swaying gently in the virtual current.

✨ Zero Stress, Infinite Comfort

  • True Peace of Mind: No tedious survival meters, no death penalties. Even if you leave the game closed for days, your corals will still be blooming beautifully to welcome you back.

Put the ocean in your screen and keep it by your desk. Keep working, keep typing, and start your healing journey today.

store_data.about_the_game:
Buerokratie Idler: Germany is a satirical idle/clicker game about a fictional German-style bureaucracy filled with forms, stamps, offices, and reforms.

You start with a tiny office, process your first forms by hand, and gradually build an ever-growing bureaucracy machine. What begins as a few cases and stamps slowly turns into a layered administrative system with new offices, upgrades, federal states, reform paths, and collection goals.

The core loop is simple: process forms, build resources, buy upgrades, and unlock the next administrative step. With every expansion, the machine becomes more efficient, more absurd, and a little more official-looking - but only inside the game.

Buerokratie Idler: Germany leans into dry humor, fictional administrative logic, and a retro office-PC interface. It is not a realistic government simulation. It is an intentionally exaggerated idle game about the strangely satisfying escalation of paperwork.

Features:

- Process forms and increase your administrative throughput

- Unlock new offices, upgrades, and progression systems

- Expand the machine through federal states, reforms, and stamp paths

- Collect in-game achievements and build out your stamp archive

- Play inside a dry, satirical office-PC interface

- Single-player idle/clicker progression with no real public services

German and English are the primary reviewed language options. Additional experimental language options are also included.

Fictional Satire Disclaimer:

Buerokratie Idler: Germany is an independent fictional satire game about an imaginary bureaucracy. It is not operated, supported, reviewed, endorsed, or authorized by any government agency, public authority, ministry, municipality, federal state, or public institution. The game is not an official simulation, does not represent real administrative services, and does not provide legal, administrative, or government advice. It does not use or imitate official sovereign symbols, government seals, agency logos, coats of arms, or official emblems.

store_data.about_the_game:
College life was supposed to be simple: attend classes, make friends, and survive another semester.

Instead, you’ve found yourself navigating a bizarre world of eccentric students, strange professors, unexpected side quests, and the everyday chaos of art school life.

College Quest is a retro-inspired point-and-click adventure that captures the charm and humor of classic Sierra adventures from the late 80s and 90s while adding modern conveniences and a unique college setting. Explore a hand-crafted campus, solve puzzles, collect items, attend classes, and make choices that shape your journey.

Inspired by classics like King’s Quest, Space Quest, Leisure Suit Larry, and other golden-age adventure games, College Quest blends humor, exploration, and storytelling into a nostalgic adventure with its own personality.

Features

• Explore a large college campus filled with classrooms, dorms, hidden areas, and secrets
• Solve puzzles using classic point-and-click adventure gameplay
• Meet quirky students, professors, and memorable characters
• Experience humorous dialogue and unexpected situations
• Complete classes, assignments, and side adventures
• Discover multiple outcomes based on your performance and choices
• Retro-inspired visuals and gameplay inspired by classic Sierra adventures
• Designed with modern quality-of-life improvements while preserving old-school charm

Will you graduate with honors… or barely survive the year?

store_data.about_the_game:
Just a Little Longer is a punishing top-down shooter with the staples of classic action horror games, with a brutal permadeath gambling twist: whenever you die in the recurring nightmare the game takes place in, your save file is instantly deleted. To combat this, you can choose to "wake up" at any point, instantly returning you to safety, but reverting the nightmare back to the beginning. However, inventory items, guns, upgrades, and shortcuts unlocked remain as they were before the awakening. The question is: do you play it safe and return to the safety of your bed, or do you keep going, trying to find the cause of the nightmare — and keep dreaming just a little longer?

Transient shades and terrible unknown creatures stalk the depths of the nightmare, and ammo to defeat these foes are scarce and vital. Upgrades throughout the game will make defeating these foes easier, as long as you are able to retain them by not dying, and witnessing these foes allows them to be researched upon waking.

A large connected game world that wraps back on itself with numerous shortcuts and methods of transportation to unlock. Unlocking these shortcuts is crucial to soften the impact of choosing to wake up. As soon as shortcuts are opened, they are never closed, making repeat ventures into the nightmare more and more efficient.

store_data.about_the_game:
《Lord Return》is an interactive cinematic game of rebirth and revenge. Play as the residual soul of a Demon Lord betrayed across two lifetimes, bound to the Beauty Destiny System. Explore mystical realms, fight battles, unravel conspiracies, and bond with six Maidens of Destiny to rebuild your demonic body and grow stronger. Uncover the impostor ruse and the world-ending plot, decide the story’s fate, battle at Fallen Demon Cliff, reverse destiny, protect your loved ones, and face the ultimate trial of a higher dimension.

Story Background

In his previous life, Demon Lord Ye Mingchen was betrayed by his beloved Jiang Wan and the righteous leader Xiao He, falling to his death at Fallen Demon Cliff.

The soul of a modern business elite merged with him, reborn with the hatred of two lifetimes. He accidentally bound the Beauty Destiny System—only by gathering six righteous women with Destiny Shards across the three realms and forging deep bonds can he rebuild his body and avenge himself.

He survives desperate dangers, saves the cold swordswoman Lin Wei, the dragon-blooded exiled princess Su Yao, the nine-tailed fox princess Bai Ling’er, the mechanism genius Mu Qingcheng, and the pure-yin maiden Liu Hanyan. He uncovers the shocking truth: the traitor is Jiang Chen, Jiang Wan’s twin sister, while the real Jiang Wan’s soul has been imprisoned all along.

Together, they foil Xiao He’s evil plan to collect blood crystals and build a world-destroying formation. In the final battle at Fallen Demon Cliff, they collect all six Destiny Shards, break through to Godhood, and defeat their enemy.

When peace returns, they realize this world is only a “cradle trial” by higher-dimensional beings—and a greater crisis has just begun…

Game Features

Item Collection

You can collect various items through different storylines and unlock corresponding achievements.

Save & Rewind

You may rewind to any previous progress at any time to search for clues.

Character Collection

Story progression is mainly achieved by unlocking and collecting different characters during the game.

store_data.about_the_game:
《Force Purge》is a visual novel blending Chinese folk horror, supernatural investigation, and branching storytelling. Play as Wang Taqing, a Taoist exorcist posing as a scientific consultant, team up with psychic cop Lin Mengzhu. Investigate haunted cases, use talismans and formations to eliminate evil, uncover the Sword Lenders’ conspiracy to open the ghost gate, make critical choices, and fight the underworld invasion to decide the fate of the mortal world.

Story Background

On the night of the Blood Moon, the boundary between the human world and the underworld collapses. Wang Taqing, a Taoist from Longhu Mountain, disguises himself as a scientific consultant to eliminate evil spirits. He teams up with Lin Mengzhu, a policewoman with psychic eyes, to solve supernatural cases. They uncover a conspiracy by the Sword Lenders, who plan to wake a thousand-year-old evil soldier with blood sacrifices, open the Gate of Fengdu, and invade the human world with underworld armies.

Item Collection

You can collect various items through different storylines and unlock corresponding achievements.

Character Collection

Story progression is mainly achieved by unlocking and collecting different characters during the game.

Interact with various characters in the game to uncover story details.

《Lich King Bond》 is a visual novel game.You play Lin Feng, who awakens a reversed system: the closer you stay to the S-Class Zombie Queen Hongye, the safer you are. Tame her with hot pot and pudding, turn her lair into a safe hotel, guard your clingy zombie queen, and dominate the wasteland!

Story Background

Ten years ago, the red mist swept the world. 90% of humanity turned into zombies, civilization collapsed, and survivors struggled to survive. An ordinary young man named Lin Feng accidentally traveled to the apocalypse. At the brink of death, he awakened the system: The Closer to Danger, the Safer. He could only gain invincible defense by staying within 3 meters of S-class or above monsters. To survive, he broke into the forbidden "Zombie Queen’s Palace". He tamed Hongye, the food-loving S-class zombie queen, with delicious food, making her his bodyguard and mascot. He turned the forbidden zone into the only safe haven in the apocalypse, the "Doomsday Peace Hotel". As humans came to seek refuge and powerful enemies arrived, Lin Feng relied on his wits and sincere protection to form a soul bond with Hongye. Together, they fought against the SS-class Zombie Emperor, starting a hilarious apocalypse nurturing and love comedy.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are plagued by nightmares featuring your deceased younger sister, “Haru.” You head to a village in search of memories of Haru and the secret behind the nightmares. There, you must perform a “Ritual of Sacrifice” for five days.

Rules of the <Ritual of Sacrifice>

- Come alone.

-Every morning, draw a slip of paper from the box in front of the shrine and bring back the <Sacrifice> written on it.

-Do not go outside after sunset; if you absolutely must, cover your eyes.

-Do not answer any voices you hear inside the shrine.

For just five days, perform the Sacrifice Ritual and explore the village.

But you will never make it to the final day.

Because as a human, you cannot go any further.

Always be cautious and suspicious—of yourself and of your day.

Features

“Haru” is a walking simulator in the horror genre.

You must explore the village for 5 days and offer sacrifices at the shrine.

Playtime

20–45 minutes

store_data.about_the_game:
The Undergrowth is an online multiplayer survival experience where you begin life as a tiny, vulnerable creature in a massive ecosystem filled with danger, opportunity, and other players. Hunt, scavenge, grow, evolve, and carve your place in a brutal world where survival is never guaranteed.

Explore dense forests, dark underground tunnels, wetlands, cliffsides, rivers, and hidden nests as you battle both the environment and other players in intense PvP and PvE encounters. Every choice matters, whether you become a stealthy ambush predator, a territorial brute, or a fast-moving scavenger trying to stay alive another day.

Grow from hatchling to apex creature by managing hunger, thirst, stamina, injuries, and shelter while navigating a constantly changing ecosystem driven by real players and AI wildlife.

Survival in The Undergrowth is unforgiving.

Manage hunger, thirst, stamina, injuries, temperature, and exhaustion as you navigate a dangerous world where even smaller creatures can become deadly in the right situation. Search for safe water sources, protect your shelter, and avoid becoming prey while exploring a constantly evolving environment.

Weather, time of day, environmental hazards, and creature behavior all affect how you survive. Heavy rain may expose hidden tunnels while droughts can force predators and prey into the same shrinking water sources.

Death carries consequences, making every encounter meaningful.

Begin life as a weak juvenile and slowly grow into a powerful adult creature.

As you survive, hunt, and explore, your creature matures physically over time, unlocking improved abilities, increased strength, new behaviors, and expanded survival options. Your journey from vulnerable hatchling to apex predator is shaped by the choices you make and the dangers you overcome.

Every stage of life changes gameplay:

  • Juveniles focus on stealth and survival

  • Adolescents begin competing for territory and food

  • Adults dominate through strength, speed, or intelligence

Staying alive long enough to fully mature is an achievement on its own.

The world of The Undergrowth is filled with danger from both players and AI creatures.

Engage in brutal PvP encounters over territory, nests, food sources, and survival. Ambush unsuspecting prey, defend your group, or stalk enemies through dense vegetation and underground tunnel systems.

AI wildlife creates additional threats and opportunities throughout the world. Some creatures may flee at the first sign of danger, while others aggressively defend territory or hunt in packs.

Combat is immersive and grounded, rewarding positioning, timing, awareness, and strategy over mindless attacks.

The ecosystem is alive and constantly changing.

Creature populations shift based on player activity, migration patterns, hunting pressure, and environmental conditions. Predators influence prey behavior while scavengers benefit from the aftermath of battles and hunts.

Players naturally shape the world around them:

  • Overhunting can reduce prey populations

  • Territorial creatures can dominate entire regions

  • Group behavior changes how areas of the map evolve

  • Migration and nesting patterns create unpredictable encounters

No two play sessions feel exactly the same.

Explore a massive world built around verticality, danger, and discovery.

Travel through:

  • Dense forests

  • Underground cave systems

  • Rocky cliffsides

  • Rivers and wetlands

  • Abandoned burrows

  • Hidden nesting grounds

  • Dangerous open fields

Different environments support different creature behaviors and playstyles. Some creatures thrive in darkness and tight tunnels, while others rely on open terrain and speed to survive.

Secrets, hidden pathways, and environmental storytelling reward players willing to explore deeper into the world.

Customize your creature with detailed skin and appearance options.

Unlock and create unique skin patterns, colors, markings, and visual traits that allow you to stand out within the ecosystem. Blend into your environment with natural camouflage or create intimidating appearances that make your presence known.

Customization allows players to create creatures that feel personal while still fitting naturally into the world of The Undergrowth.

Future updates may expand customization with:

  • Rare skin variants

  • Seasonal cosmetics

  • Pattern editors

  • Creature-specific customization options

Survive alone or form groups with other players.

Create packs, colonies, hunting groups, or territorial alliances to increase your chances of survival. Cooperative gameplay allows players to coordinate hunts, defend nests, protect juveniles, and dominate territory together.

But trust is never guaranteed.

Betrayal, competition, and territorial conflict are always part of the ecosystem.

Every creature you encounter has its own goals and not all of them are friendly.

In The Undergrowth, you are not the hero.

You are simply another creature trying to survive in a world where everything is hunting something.

StockShock is a next-generation 3D stylish action game that fuses high-speed combat with the high-stakes tension of stock market investing. Take on risks to empower your foes, reap the dividends, and watch your own abilities skyrocket through "compound interest." Experience an exhilarating, explosive power-scaling build battle where high risk breeds ultimate power!

2. About This Game

Govern the Risk. Overwhelm with Compound Interest. StockShock is a groundbreaking 3D stylish action game that seamlessly injects the strategic dilemmas of investing into high-speed combat.

■ Core System: Upfront Investment Build

  • 【The Choice】 At the start of each stage, you choose between three critical binary forks to grow your stats (HP/Defense, Attack/MP, Speed/Stamina).

  • 【Automated Enemy Investment】 The moment you strike a full-health enemy, the choice you didn't pick is instantly invested into that enemy, triggering real-time evolution and aggressive behavior.

  • 【Securing Profits (Liquidation)】 Overcome the heightened threat with raw player skill. Defeating the enemy liquidates your assets—granting massive dividends to your chosen stats and returning the enemy's boosted power back to you as capital.

■ Unparalleled Growth & Domination Your invested stats accumulate like snowballs through the power of compound interest. The higher the risks you brave by empowering your enemies early on, the more catastrophically you can demolish them later with god-like, rule-breaking strength. Master the high-risk, high-return market of the battlefield and claim your ultimate returns!

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Monitoball, a cozy creature-sports management game about building a team, raising a home, and helping your strange little athletes become legends.

Take charge of a humble squad of monitos: tiny, oddball competitors with big personalities, hidden talents, favorite comforts, and plenty of room to grow. Scout new recruits, upgrade your team house, and guide your roster through weekly plans and entire careers!

Building a great team is not just about stats. Your monitos form friendships, spark rivalries, develop traits, gain fame, and carve out their own place in the league. Some recruits are obvious stars. Others are hidden gems waiting for the right coach, the right home, or the right chance on the field.

Between matches, upgrade your team hub and watch your roster live their little lives: running drills, lounging in the rec room, resting in bed, soaking in the sauna, sharing meals, and sometimes just being little goofs.

Then head to the recruiting office, scout the wilds, review scrimmages, and find the next rookie monito worthy of your squad. You’re not the only coach hunting for talent, though. Rival teams are chasing the same prospects, and every recruit wants something different. Learn what matters to them, play to your team’s strengths, and convince them to choose you over the competition!

Features:

  • Recruit adorable, strange, and spirited monitos!

  • Scout hidden stats, preferences, traits, and potential!

  • Upgrade rooms for training, recovery, dining, recreation, and sleep!

  • Build friendships, rivalries, fame, and team chemistry!

  • Manage seasons full of wins, losses, growth, and offseason decisions!

  • Customize your coach and build a program that is uniquely yours!

  • Become the greatest Monitoball coach of all time!

store_data.about_the_game:
Warrior's Memory: The Hollow Strata

Warrior's Memory: The Hollow Strata is a card game where you build your deck before each challenge, then collect, fuse, and upgrade cards as you battle your way through the Strata.

With over 1,000 cards, flexible pre-run deckbuilding, and fusion-based upgrades, create your own combos and take on powerful enemies.

Key Features

Over 1,000 Cards

Discover a wide variety of cards, with more planned for future updates.

Strategic Pre-Run Deckbuilding

By fighting repeatedly and leveling up your character, you can expand your deckbuilding options. Add stronger cards and more powerful combos to your deck before each challenge.

Grow Stronger Through Card Fusion

Fuse cards of the same level to create a stronger card one tier higher.

Collect Cards and Items

Use in-game currency to buy and collect cards and items. Items can also be added to your deck before a challenge, opening up even more strategic possibilities.

A Unique Daifugō-Style Mini-Game

Includes a special mini-game inspired by Daifugō, also known as President.

Combat

Deploy your units against the enemy’s formation and fight back with your own.

Withstand enemy attacks, deal damage, and reduce the enemy’s HP to zero to win.

The BT System

This game features a unique combat system where the enemy’s BT becomes your combat power, while your BT becomes the enemy’s combat power.

Rather than focusing only on your own strength, success depends on choosing the right units for each opponent.

Skills and Assist Cards

Many cards can be deployed as units, but they can also be used as Assist Cards to turn the tide of battle.

Cards also have a wide range of skills. By using them effectively, even weaker units can defeat stronger enemies.

Library

In the Library, you can view detailed information on the cards you have collected.

Browsing your collection and planning new decks and combos is part of the experience.

About Early Access

This game is currently in development.

We plan to continue updating it with new cards, modes, and system expansions.

Development updates and additional information are posted on note.

Depending on the state of development, we may also hold community-oriented events that players can participate in.

Planned Updates

  • A new mini board game inspired by Mahjong and Donjara, using in-game cards

  • Continued expansion with a goal of exceeding 4,000 total cards

  • New special Strata that expand the main ADVENTURE mode

  • Additional new game modes that differ from the existing modes

About the Use of AI

AI has been used in parts of the programming process, as well as in many card and UI design elements.

Depending on future development conditions, we plan to gradually replace key card illustrations with redrawn versions by illustrators.

store_data.about_the_game:
An evil witch is abducting people across the Falcon Duchy and is using them for horrific rituals. Join Vance and Skye, two mercenaries, as they seek to end her tyranny of evil.

Features

  • A detailed grid-based combat system, which incorporates formation changes, front and back rows, and area of effect abilities and spells. You have full control over the party's initial placement in battle, and they can move once per turn.

  • Most melee weapons can only hit the front line, but missile weapons, spells, and some abilities can hit almost any foe you wish.

  • Tons of weapons, armor, necklaces, rings, and more, to build the characters the way you want. Special gems boost the powers of your favorite skills, but you can only wear two at a time!

  • A complex storyline full of twists and turns. Allies will become enemies, and vice-versa. Trials of Tenebrae explores themes of nihilism, family, the meaning of life, and dealing with trauma.

  • Five playable characters, which are completely customizable. Focus on ice magic, explosives, shield proficiency, lockpicking, and anything in between.

  • Four difficulty levels which can be changed any time you're out of battle.

  • Over a hundred unique, hand-crafted battles to take part in. No two fights are the same.

  • Charming graphics in the style of the late 90s and early 2000s classics.

  • Status effects, bonuses, and penalties will help or hinder you during the journey. Mouseover a character or enemy, and all of their statuses will be explained in an easy to read pop-up.

  • Powerful spells will take time to cast, and Free Actions are special abilities that allow a character to instantly act again. Some fights will grant the heroes temporary abilities that are vital to winning.

  • Trials of Tenebrae is a linear adventure focusing on battles, dialogue and cutscenes, and visiting merchants to outfit your party. There is no grinding, so pick your characters' skills wisely!

  • Characters that deal (and heal) the most damage will have the enemy's attention, or aggro. To help tweak aggro management in your favor, a variety of options are available, like the Ring of Pacifism, or the skill, Callout.

  • Choose your actions carefully. Some decisions will have repercussions later!

Characters

Vance

Vance is a captain of the Guineverian Guardians. His life changes when his home is attacked by demons, and he travels, looking to quench the rage forever burning in his heart. Gruff and a bit greedy, Vance will stop at nothing to achieve his primary goal. Vance has recently become Favoured, gaining the divine blessing of Ishtan, God of Endurance and the Sun.

Skye

Quiet and distant, Skye is Vance's traveling companion and best friend. Having renounced her title as a Guardian, she seeks to reuniite with her uncle, Owein, who lives at the border of the Falcon Duchy. Having not seen her uncle in months, Skye looks forward to catching up with the only family member she has left.

store_data.about_the_game:
🪨 Bounce. Break. Mine.

Pickball is what happens when the satisfying clack of pinball collides with the addictive growth of an incremental game. You start with a single humble pickaxe — and before you know it, one launch is sweeping an entire screen of ore into your pocket.

⛏️ Core Gameplay

Launch Your Pickaxe — From the primitive tool that began civilization, to dragon-clawed picks, to mystical instruments imbued with the power of the moon. Collect and upgrade pickaxes, each with their own quirks and special effects.

Smash the Ore — Stones, copper, iron, titanium, tungsten, gold, sapphire, ruby, emerald, diamond. The higher the tier, the flashier the shatter — and the fatter the payout.

Dig Deeper — From dusty scrap-iron shafts to the golden Tutankhamun tomb and ancient gold-vein fields, every stage hides new ores and richer rewards.

💎 Numbers That Go Brrr

At first, even a tiny pebble feels precious. Soon, chain mining, pickaxe explosions, drop multipliers, treasure drops, and coin showers paint the entire screen gold. Slot in attachments for lightning, tremors, lasers, even ghostly phasing — and turn a single swing into a mineshaft-wide earthquake.

🗿 Crack the Boss Rocks

At the end of every stage looms a massive Boss Rock — thick, stubborn, and built to take a beating. But when it finally cracks open? There’s nothing quite like it.

🏆 Built to Collect

Gem Codex — Fill out your collection as you unearth every mineral.

Mastery System — Permanent progression that makes every future swing stronger.

Hidden Treasures — Rare prizes buried somewhere in the rubble. You’ll have to dig to find them.

🎯 You’ll Love This If…

You love the satisfying thock of a good pinball bounce.

Watching numbers get bigger genuinely makes you happy.

“Just one more run” has been known to last until 3 AM.

You want a game packed with screen-shaking effects and crunchy sound to melt the day’s stress away.

Grab your pick. The mine is deep, and the ore is infinite.

store_data.about_the_game:
Ten Rings 2 is a turn-based RPG where every character is built from 10 rings.

There are no fixed class limits. A fighter, mage, tank, healer, summoner, trickster, or strange hybrid build can all come from the rings you equip. Stats, skills, passive effects, battle roles, and special mechanics are driven by rings, so changing your loadout can completely change how a character plays.

10 rings define each character

Every character has 10 ring slots. Fill them with stat rings, skill rings, passive rings, weapon rings, elemental rings, and stranger tools to create your own build. Stack reliable bonuses, chase unusual synergies, or rebuild a character for a specific encounter.

Mix roles freely

Classes are not locked to characters. Any party member can become a damage dealer, defender, support caster, control specialist, resource engine, or hybrid role depending on their rings. Your party is shaped by your decisions, not by a preset job list.

Use enemy abilities

Enemies also fight through ring-based builds. Their abilities are not separate from the player system. If an enemy has a powerful trick, that trick can become part of your own strategy through rings.

Fight tactical turn-based battles

Battles are about reading the situation and making your ring setup work: action timing, HP, MP, elemental effects, passive triggers, recovery, defense, and skill costs all matter. The same character can feel completely different after changing a few rings.

Explore, adapt, rebuild

Move through stage maps, manage your party's condition, choose encounters, and adjust your rings as new options appear. After battle, borrowed enemy rings can open new builds and give you fresh ways to solve the next fight.

Key features

  • Every character is built from 10 freely combined rings

  • Stats, skills, passives, roles, and special mechanics are ring-driven

  • Mix class-like roles without fixed job restrictions

  • Use abilities that enemies use against you

  • Turn-based battles built around party composition and ring synergy

  • Stage exploration, equipment management, shops, story dialogue, and unlockable gallery content

  • Use abilities that enemies use against you

store_data.about_the_game:
One engine. Infinite stories. Your rules.

Story Engine is not a game with a pre-written plot. It is a narrative engine that revolves around you — every choice, every word,

every direction takes the story somewhere completely different.

Pick a world. Pick a companion. Pick a GM persona. Then the story begins.

Walk into a tavern. Start a war. Fall in love. Betray a kingdom. Open a bakery in a quiet village. No dialogue wheels. No invisible

walls. You describe what you do — the AI unfolds what happens next.

Five GM Personas

The GM is the soul of every tabletop campaign. Choose the one that fits your mood:

  • Death — Cold. Inevitable. Every choice has a cost, and the bill always comes due.

  • Prophet — The world whispers of what's to come. Every scene drips with foreshadowing.

  • Gambler — Luck, risk, and unexpected twists. Nothing is guaranteed.

  • Mentor — Patient. Guiding. The world teaches you its rules, if you're willing to learn.

  • Confidant — Intimate. Character-driven. Every NPC has a heartbeat.

Built for Roleplayers

  • Import your own character cards (PNG format supported)

  • Companion mode with relationship tracking — guardian, rival, confidant, or something unspoken

  • Inventory, quest log, and active party tracking

  • Three difficulty levels — from Relaxed to Brutal (not recommended without extensive preparations)

  • Progressive world-building — lore entries unlock as the story unfolds

Bring your own key. Play free.

No subscription. No hidden fees. Connect your own API key and the engine runs at cost — roughly $0.14 per hour of play. If you'd rather not deal with API setup, use the relay service via one-time Steam DLC.

You can also connect your own image generation API for character portraits and scene illustrations.

Made by a non-programmer. With Claude Code.

The developer had never written a line of code before this project. The entire engine was built through conversations with AI. If that sounds wrong — it probably is.

Welcome to Story Engine.

store_data.about_the_game:
Type a command. Open the story.

Stories Terminal brings back the feel of classic text adventures in a cleaner, more approachable form. Instead of clicking through a fixed list of choices, you type your own commands: look around, inspect the vial, search the desk, use the card, call the police. The terminal answers, and the story moves with what you uncover.

The first scenario takes you to a midnight campus at Vilnius University. You play as a detective investigating the death of Marek Nowak, a biology teacher. A body lies in the courtyard, chemical traces lead toward the lab, and the basement hides the darker part of the case. Every clue can matter.

Classic form, modern flow

Stories Terminal keeps the spirit of old text games: read, think, type your decision. At the same time, it helps you stay in the story with flexible command recognition, contextual hints, autosave, and atmospheric pixel-art backgrounds.

  • Typed commands - try your own actions instead of only choosing from buttons.

  • Evidence-driven investigation - gather the right clues before making the final call.

  • Pixel-art atmosphere - a dark campus, silent hallways, labs, and basements frame the case.

  • Multiple endings - the finale depends on what you have discovered.

  • A terminal for many stories - Stories Terminal is built as a place for future scenarios, genres, and cases.

  • PL/EN - supports Polish and English.

Who is it for?

For players who enjoy narrative games, detective mysteries, old-school adventures, text parsers, and stories where careful reading matters more than reflexes.

store_data.about_the_game:
A Classic Point & Click Adventure

Step into the shoes of Godefroy in this lovingly crafted, episodic 2D adventure game. Built from the ground up to recreate the golden era of 90s gaming, The Adventures of Godefroy brings back the joy of bizarre inventory puzzles, eccentric NPCs, and a world where your biggest enemy is the developer who coded it.

The Ultimate Meta-Mystery

Godefroy is just trying to catch the school bus at first, but the universe has other plans. The Game Studio is actively trying to eliminate Godefroy to save rendering and server costs. To survive, you must expose Mombosa Games. From dodging deadly falling branches to navigating the treacherous social hierarchy of the schoolyard playground, survival requires wit, patience, and a healthy dose of sarcasm.

Key Features:

  • Classic Puzzle Mechanics: Examine, interact, and combine absurd items. Need a hook? Try combining a Weird Branch with a Metal Rod. Need to get past an underground "Genius IT Guy"? You'll have to forge, steal, or hack Premium Mombosa Tokens. * Master the Art of Insults: Prove you are cool enough to deal with the underground network by collecting a specific repertoire of insults from around the schoolyard and successfully deploying them in a high-stakes insult duel.

  • Dynamic Color System: Explore the world in glorious 256 colors, or swallow the B/W Pill to plunge the game into monochrome grayscale to please your older video card.

  • Retro Visual Filters: Switch seamlessly between crisp 1X Windowed mode, scanlined P3 Phosphor, or go full nostalgia with simulated CGA and EGA palettes.

  • Play At Your Own Pace: No Quick Time Events. No combat. Just you, your inventory, and a school-wide game of Tag where Mombosa’s anti-cheat tracking locks onto you.

Two weeks of radio silence. Vel’Aris has fallen into darkness. The United Planet Authority has deployed Alpha and Bravo squads for what was supposed to be a simple declassified recovery. But reality on Vel’Aris has become a nightmare. Take command of the G.O.D. satellite system and turn the orbit into your battlefield.

store_data.about_the_game:
Kagenazo is a 3D shadow puzzle game built around a simple idea: a shape can look completely different depending on where the light is coming from.

Build the Right Shape

Each puzzle gives you a set of target silhouettes. Your goal is to build a cube structure that casts the correct shadows from multiple directions. Add and remove cube blocks, rotate the shape to inspect it, and compare the result against the target patterns until every shadow matches.

Think in Shadows

The rules are easy to read at a glance, but the solutions require spatial thinking. A block that fixes one face may ruin another. A shape that looks right from the front may be wrong from above.

As the puzzles grow from compact 2x2 cubes to larger 3x3 and 4x4 structures, you will need to think in layers, mentally rotate shapes, and find forms that satisfy every view at once.

Over 190 Handcrafted Puzzles

Kagenazo includes over 190 handcrafted puzzles across multiple cube sizes. Early levels introduce the logic of shadow matching step by step, while later puzzles ask for more efficient construction and sharper observation. Larger cubes add extra depth, letting you hide, reveal, and reason through internal layers as you search for the intended solution.

Improve Your Solutions

Every level tracks your performance with a star rating based on how efficiently you solve it and how quickly you finish. You can complete a puzzle through experimentation, then return later to improve your solution with fewer cubes and a better score.

Clean and Focused Puzzle Design

With clean controls, responsive cube interaction, and a quiet visual style focused on light and form, Kagenazo is designed for players who enjoy spatial puzzles, logical deduction, and the satisfaction of seeing a complex shape finally cast the exact shadows you were chasing.

store_data.about_the_game:
Hunk Battle Gems is a colorful turn-based match-3 battle game where every swap is part puzzle, part duel, and part resource plan.

Face a roster of powerful rivals in one-on-one elemental battles. On your turn, you can spend elemental MP on a skill, then make a single gem swap on the 8x8 board. Matching gems deals damage, builds MP, triggers cascades, and opens the door to bigger follow-up turns. Your rival follows the same rules, using their own affinities, skills, and AI-controlled moves to fight back.

Each rival has different elemental strengths and weaknesses. A simple match can keep you alive, but smart pattern play is how you take control: line up bigger shapes, chain cascades, gather the MP you need, and choose the right moment to strike or recover.

Winning battles raises your relationship with each rival. As bonds grow, you unlock new gallery content, including character CGs and movies, along with progression rewards tied to the full game loop.

Sonar Mining Co. is an immersive PS1-style first-person incremental submarine mining game set in the depths of a mysterious ocean.

You work for a deep-sea mining corporation tasked with descending into dark, dangerous waters in search of valuable ore and lost technology. Using your sonar, mining equipment, and specialized tools, you’ll explore massive underwater caverns, navigate tight trenches, and extract resources while managing the limitations of your rusty submarine.

Each expedition earns you credits that can be used to incrementally upgrade your vessel. As your submarine becomes more advanced, you’ll be able to dive deeper into uncharted zones where rarer materials and stranger discoveries await.

Between runs, you can customize and decorate the subs interior, optimize your equipment loadout, and prepare for the next descent.

But the ocean floor hides more than just ore deposits. The deeper you go, the more the secrets of the Sonar Mining Co. begin to surface.

store_data.about_the_game:
The other half of your soul — never let go.

About This Game

**Emotion turns the tide. Choice writes the ending.**

*Gemini in Flux* is a turn-based dark fantasy RPG. Whatever your characters feel during the story carries straight onto the battlefield as stat changes, and the choices you make along the way branch into four distinct endings.

**A story that begins again, in the Afterworld.**

You were supposed to be dead. Instead, a voice singing from the depths of dark water draws you upward, and you wake in a nameless forest. Waiting there is someone who seems to know you — a girl or a boy, depending on your chosen protagonist. They give you a name. The two of you begin to live together. And beyond those quiet days lies a journey: to mend the Mirror of Samsara, the relic that governs this world's laws and the cycle of rebirth.

**Grow closer to your companions. Face the truth.**

Pechi, a black cat carrying the memory of having once been deeply loved. Kaguya, a fire demon who lost her faith in humanity's selfishness. Hayate, a wind spirit forced into an unjust death — three companions join your journey.

The bond with your partner begins to waver. Feelings pass each other by. And waiting at the end is a question only you can face: why did you come to this world at all? The answer is yours to find, and yours to meet head-on.

**Love, attachment, and choosing to live again.**

This is a story about *choosing* — again — to live. Some endings are bright with hope. Others cut deep. Neither the combat nor the narrative will let you off easy.

Key Features

**💞 A journey for two — a same-sex partner at your side**

Choose your protagonist: Mizuki (girl) or Nagi (boy). Mizuki travels with Rui, a bold and self-assured girl; Nagi with Kairi, a quietly steady boy whose softness hides a core of steel. Either way, your partner is the same gender as you. The relationship will be tested, will falter, will bend — and your choices guide it toward one of four different endings.

**❤️ The Emotion System — where heart and stats are the same thing**

What the story stirs in your characters shows up directly on the battlefield. Joy raises every stat. Anger sharpens attack. Sadness deepens magic. Fear weakens both attack and magic — except in beast-type creatures (both allies and enemies), who become harder to hit when afraid. Certain items let you steer these emotional states deliberately.

**🌑 The hidden "Empathy" parameter — and four endings**

What do you say to someone who's hurting? Or do you say nothing, and just take their hand? Every word and gesture you direct at your partner is silently logged as a hidden value called *Empathy*, and it ultimately decides where your story lands. Clues scattered through the world can also unlock paths to certain endings.

**📜 *Records* — perspectives that don't quite line up**

Tucked into the corners of dungeons are fragments of writing that drifted in from the world of the living. A witch. A soldier. A cat. Each *Record* tells the story from a different angle, and it's up to you, the reader, to piece them together into something like the truth. Collecting them yields small rewards along the way.

**⚔️ Combat that rewards reading. Builds without limits.**

Four-character turn-based battles. Lean on elemental affinities — fire, water, light, dark — and racial bonuses, and use the Sharp Eye skill to expose enemy weaknesses. On top of that: **every character can equip every weapon and every piece of armor.** Daggers that bypass evasion, greatswords that stagger foes — mix and match across eight weapon categories and their skill sets to forge a build that's yours alone. Fights with real teeth.

**🔰 Built for players who are here for the story**

Alongside **Normal Mode**, which delivers combat at its intended challenge, there's a **Story Mode** for players who'd rather sink into the narrative.

In either mode, if a tough boss wipes your party, you can **instantly retry from the state you started the fight in**.

Full English localization available at launch — Japanese and English supported from day one.
