store_data.about_the_game:
This is a visual novel game centered on the Gospel accounts of the Bible. Through chapter-based storytelling, character dialogue, and event CGs, players will step into the time of Jesus Christ and witness His teachings, miracles, compassion, sacrifice, redemption, and resurrection.

The game follows the life of Jesus Christ as its main narrative, presenting many important events from the Gospels. From the birth of John the Baptist, the baptism of Jesus, His temptation in the wilderness, the calling of the disciples, and the preaching of the Kingdom of Heaven, to healing the sick, comforting the weak, and facing doubt and temptation, players will gradually experience the journey that changed the world.

This is not a game focused on combat or puzzles, but a quiet, profound narrative experience filled with meaning and faith. Through the form of a visual novel, this game hopes to help players rediscover the messages, scenes, and Word of God found in the Gospels in a more immersive way.

Features

  • Centered on the life of Jesus Christ and the stories of the four Gospels

  • Chapter-based storytelling, suitable for players who enjoy story-driven and text-based experiences

  • Character emotions and the core of faith are presented through dialogue and narration

  • Recommended for players interested in the Bible, faith, history, and narrative-driven games

In a world of darkness, He brought light.
Among the broken, He brought hope.
This is a journey of sacrifice, compassion, redemption, and resurrection.

store_data.about_the_game:
FLY TOGETHER. FLY REAL.

Bandos FPV is a multiplayer drone sim built for the way people actually fly — with friends, in voice chat, sharing the line. Whether you're a real-world pilot who wants somewhere to keep your thumbs sharp or you've never touched a transmitter in your life, the same drones are waiting for you. The difference is just how much help you want.

━━━ THREE MODES, ONE DRONE ━━━

- ANGLE — Self-leveling. The sticks point the drone where you want to look. Let go, and the drone returns to level. This is how a Mavic flies.

- HORIZON — Self-levels near center, lets you flip when you slam the sticks. The honest middle ground.

- ACRO — Pure rate control. The drone holds whatever angle you put it at. This is real FPV. Crashes, sweat, the works.

Layer on independent assists when you want them: Air Mode for control on zero-throttle dives, Altitude Hold for cinematic shots, Position Hold for hovering steady, Turtle Mode for flipping back upright after the inevitable.

━━━ HARDWARE THAT FEELS REAL ━━━

Every drone in Bandos has real specs driving real behavior. Battery cells, motor KV, prop pitch, mass, thrust-to-weight — these aren't cosmetic numbers on a spec sheet. They shape how the drone flies.

- REAL LIPO BATTERIES — Punch the throttle and voltage sags. Drain the pack, and your motors get weaker. Run it empty, and you wallow out of the sky.  Land on a recharge pad to get back in the fight.

- TUNES YOU CAN CYCLE IN-FLIGHT — Each drone ships with multiple Betaflight- style tunes. Smooth for cruising. Aggressive for tricks. Race-tuned for speed. Cycle between them mid-air the same way you would in real life.

- AUTHENTIC FEEL ACROSS DEVICES — Native support for radio transmitters,  gamepads, and keyboard. Tune the expo, rates, and stick smoothing per drone.

━━━ MULTIPLAYER FIRST ━━━

- VOICE CHAT — Talk while you fly. The whole point.

- SHARED FREESTYLE — Drop into a server, find a friend, find a building, see what happens.

- MATCH MODES — Freestyle session, timed matches, racing, and cinematic modes.

━━━ THE ROADMAP ━━━

Bandos is built to grow with its community. Here's what's coming:

- RACING — Gates, lap times, leaderboards.

- CINEMATIC / PHOTO MODE — Capture footage, share screenshots, get the shot.

- TUNE SHARING — Upload your favorite tune and let others fly it.

- MAP BUILDER — Build your own freestyle spots and race courses. Share them.

- MORE DRONES — Cinewhoops, long-range rigs, micro builds.

If you fly real drones, this is your indoor track for the rainy days. If you've never flown one, this is how you find out whether you want to. Either way, there's a stick waiting and a friend in voice chat.

See you in the sky.

Tale Sweeper is a casual incremental adventure game. Move your cursor to auto-attack enemies within range while skills cast automatically!

Defeating monsters and completing quests yields materials and gold, with a rare chance to drop powerful Artifacts and Orbs.

Shop

Forge

Orbs

Artifacts

Artifacts provide unique passive abilities. Equip up to three per battle to create powerful, game-changing synergies!

store_data.about_the_game:
- Dungeon Monster Master

An ultimate action RPG set in an infinite open-world where you collect monsters, farm, and build your own world!

Become the protagonist of a mysterious world, tame and grow over 200 cute monsters, and build your own home.

Craft your own tools and face powerful boss monsters waiting for you.

Your grown monsters will protect you.

Enjoy thrilling boss battles in boss rush mode.

Explore a randomly changing, procedurally generated open world.

- Boss Dungeon with Powerful Bosses Waiting

You become the protagonist of a mysterious monster world and must find dungeons containing boss monsters to challenge them and save the world.

Collect and train monsters to fight boss monsters, defeat them, and obtain dungeon badges.

Collect all badges to challenge the final boss.

Combo attacks, dodging, and thrilling boss battles await you.

- Monster Collection and Training

Over 200 different monsters inhabit this mysterious world.

You can collect and tame these monsters.

Each monster has different abilities and growth rates.

Build your ultimate monster party of companions.

Well-trained monsters evolve into even stronger forms through evolution.

Collect special eggs found throughout the world and raise the monsters that hatch from them.

Build monster farms and raise them there.

Collect all monsters in the world and complete your monster encyclopedia collection.

- Various Attributes and Skills

There are many different attributes in this mysterious monster world:

Pickaxe, sword, fire, water, grass, electricity, angel, demon, darkness, light...

Various skills and magic also contain different attributes.

Understand and utilize attribute interactions to defeat your enemies.

In boss rush battles, your understanding of skills and magic will truly shine.

- Master All Crafting Techniques of the World

In this mysterious world, you can learn how to build houses.

The world endlessly generates various houses across randomly generated terrain.

By breaking houses, you learn how to craft them.

By breaking blocks, you learn how to craft blocks.

Discover and break anything in the world: weapons, pickaxes, torches—everything.

You will eventually be able to craft everything.

- Build Your Own City

Using the crafting techniques you learn, you can build and manage your own city.

First, clear the surrounding area to establish your city.

Then build the city you envision.

If you want to improve the environment, construct air purification buildings.

If you want to strengthen monster training, build monster farms.

To secure resources, build factories to increase city money.

- Tower Defense

Using crafting techniques discovered in the world, you can build towers that protect you and your allies.

Create various traps to gain an advantage in battle.

Your unique tower creations become the key to protecting everyone.

- Infinite Random Open World

Enjoy exploration in an endlessly expanding, randomly generated world.

Experience changing terrain, monsters, and events every time you play.

Your experience will sometimes help you, and other times surprise you with completely new situations.

store_data.about_the_game:
Alter Animus is a turn-based RPG with horror elements, mysteries to unveil and a character-driven narrative. It's up to you if these unforeseen and unthinkable circumstances make these people truly come together or if they succumb to the consequences of their actions. Uncover the truth or just try to survive in a world suddenly falling apart.

Build your party, chose your allies and make them stronger.

Trapped in darkness

Even the sun has now abandoned this wretched city. The night is here to stay and so is everyone who happened to be within the city limits after this last sunset. Nobody can leave and nobody understands why and how. Phenomena have been believed to be an impossibility in such a modern and urban society, so what can anyone still believe in now?

Some people seem to easily get lost in this darkness, maybe even becoming part of it. Others... seem to have unlocked abilities they would never have dreamed of. An unlikely group is forming to somehow make sense of all of this, even if only to get through all of it somehow.

Unknown horrors

Certain areas around the city are starting to shift and it's not only the surroundings that are shifting. They are inhabited by hostile creatures, attacking on sight. Try to stay on top and deal with these threats and be prepared to accept the help of unlikely allies. They might also assist in being able to deal with some of the things you bear witness to.

Forge bonds

Strength doesn't only lie in numbers, but also community. Don't exhaust yourself trying to only fend off the unknown. Spending time with your allies might prove invaluable. It's up to you if you want to give everyone you meet a chance though. After all, some people might deserve their fate...

Guests arrive, take their seats at the tables, and order a random cocktail from the recipes available to you. Be quick to prepare and serve the order on time — for that you earn coins and experience. And if you set up a drink barrel, patrons will buy drinks even on their way out.

🪑 Decorate your tavern

Buy tables, chairs, and benches for your guests, arrange paintings, flowers, tapestries, banners, and lighting. Decor brings cozy points and increases the experience from sales — the cozier the hall, the more profitable every order.

store_data.about_the_game:
Chaos Combat is a platform fighter created by Infernia Inferno that focuses primarily on silly bombastic characters with explosive potential! The game aims to bring a fresh outlook to the platform fighter scene by taking inspiration from both platform and traditional fighters.

Currently in a beta state, featuring 7 unique playable characters, as well as 18 stages.

Planned implementation of singleplayer modes and other stuff later, it's far from done atm

Characters ~

 Keven - A wandering piglet who fights for the weak, Keven is an all rounder character designed to be a good entryway into the feel and mechanics of the game. He wields a wide array of tools that can be used for zoning, brawling, and mobility.

 Ruby - A battle hungry glass cannon who utilizes the infernal flame as well as her sword, the Eruption. Every time she hits an opponent, her flare meter goes up, which can be spent on projectiles. Be careful though, as taking damage and recovering also consumes it!

 Rose - A friendly archer and loving girlfriend to Ruby - she plays a game of keep away using several projectiles, an ivy whip, and Nature's Wrath - a bow that can also become an axe. The more she zones the more she heals!

 Fley - A goon who uses his evil plushes, guns, vents, and crates to gain massive stage control. He has a long reaching scythe, and several devastating spikes. Beware their random crits!

 Dr. Star - A world destroying tyrant, capable of tanking planet destroying blows. He's deceptively fast, and has a long reaching axe capable of cutting his foes into pieces. You'd better be careful to not let him go too long without damage, as he'll build up passive starmor (armor).

 Ghoulia - A zombie skeleton vampire hybrid who feeds on the living, while pulling as many pranks as she can. She's rather oppressive to fight against with her many traps and pressuring tools, as well as moves that combo well into each other.

 David - A hero of many worlds, David wields power granted by four elemental orbs he keeps equipped, said orbs having names of their own - Pyro, Pulse, Frostbite, and Void. Pyro allows him to wield flames, Pulse equips him with a super-extending blade known as Storm's Wrath, Frostbite allows the use of a frozen shield with icy spikes, and Void grants the power of darkness.

There's also Carrie but she's not done yet i'm workin on it

Features ~

Grabs - Latch onto a target and toss them around! Grabs can be done both on the ground, and in midair, although will have less KB and release faster in the air. If you get grabbed, then if you hold the direction you think your opponent is going to throw you, you will escape the grab. You can also manually cause a grab escape yourself by pressing guard, if you wanted to do that for some reason.

Ledge - Latch onto ledges, and either roll from them or perform an attack up them.

Parry - If you hold the guard button, you will block most damage from targets (Minus hitgrabs as well as typical grabs) for as long as you hold it. However, if you get hit within the first few frames of guarding, you will instead perform a parry, reflecting any projectiles you were hit by, as well as giving momentary invulnerability and slowing your opponent down.

Sparkle Meter - Build up Meter by dealing damage to the opponent! It separates itself into 4 stacks, and each stack can be spent for various abilities

Sparkle Strongs - Power up your strong attacks by pressing the meter button whilst charging a strong attack! This causes it to deal higher damage and knockback. Uses a stack of meter.

Ultimaguard - Power up your guard with meter in order to block all damage, even reflecting some of it back at your target. Also blocks command grabs., and reflects projectiles. Be warned though, the longer you hold it, the more meter you use!

Armageddon Rush - Press meter and grab at the same time in order to perform the Armageddon Rush. This additionally requires to you fill up the Armageddon Crystal in it's entirety, as well as consuming a stack of meter. You will know if you can use this if a ribbon is displayed below the crystal.

The Armageddon Rush allows you to cancel all knockback as well as whatever state you are in. This can be used offensively to extend combos, or defensively to cancel all your knockback. Using it for the latter however will use up the entire crystal, and if enough knockback was blocked, fracture the crystal until you die. Fractured crystals cannot be used to Armageddon Rush out of hurtstun.

Armageddon Rush can additionally be used if no direction is held to convert your current momentum into whatever actionable state you so desire.

Ultimate - Use all your meter at once for an all out attack, uniquely styled after each character and their skillset.

For all my other platform fighter fans out there you can also Wavedash, Moonwalk, and also Hitfall.

store_data.about_the_game:
Defend — Explore — Upgrade — Return

An ancient force hides beneath the surface… and every night, it tries to break free.

In Crystal Siege, you must withstand relentless waves of enemies while protecting the crystal that holds everything together. But survival alone won’t be enough — you’ll need to use every moment of calm to expand, gather gold, and prepare for what’s coming.

Every decision matters. And every defeat… makes you stronger.

Explore

Venture beyond the safety of your base and uncover a world filled with danger, secrets, and opportunity.

Each run is unique, with unexpected events, and meaningful choices.

Defend

When darkness falls, the siege begins.

Face increasingly challenging waves of enemies, each with distinct behaviors and threats. Build defenses, position structures, and adapt your strategy to survive the night.

Learn from every attack. Improve. Endure longer.

Upgrade

Collect gold and crystals to invest it wisely to unlock powerful upgrades.

Strengthen your defenses, enhance your abilities, and shape your playstyle with each run. There’s no single path to victory — experiment and find what works best for you.

Return Stronger

Defeat is not the end.

Each attempt brings you closer to mastery. Unlock permanent upgrades, new options, and powerful advantages that will change how you face the next cycle.

In Crystal Siege, progress is never lost… it evolves.

Hold the Line

The crystal depends on you.

Will you endure long enough to uncover the truth behind the siege… or fall like those who came before?

store_data.about_the_game:
Quick arcade runs

Nova Swarm is a small arcade space shooter from Tiny Foundry. It is built around short runs, fast restarts, and trying to get a little further or score a little better each time.

Pick a ship in the hangar, launch into Sector 1, and work your way toward Sector 10. Each sector adds more enemy patterns, hazards, bonus cores, powerups, elites, and bosses.

If you clear the main route, you can keep going in Overrun and push the score higher. That usually goes well right up until it does not.

Crowded, but learnable

The screen can get busy, but the goal is that danger has a shape you can read. Enemies cut lanes, fire rings and split shots, drop mines, pull you out of position, or force you to move before you feel ready.

Bosses have tells. Hazards are meant to be learned. A good run should feel cleaner because you understood what was happening, not because the game hid less from you.

Ships that feel different

The hangar starts small and opens up as your pilot career grows. Ships have different speed, spread, fire rhythm, damage, bullet speed, and hitbox feel.

Some are steady. Some are twitchy. A few are probably bad ideas until they suddenly make sense.

Scores, unlocks, and records

A run leaves more behind than a final number. Boss kills, clean waves, no-hit moments, new enemies, Codex discoveries, pilot rank, unlocks, career stats, and run records feed back into the career profile.

The Threat Codex fills in as you meet new trouble. The Cabinet keeps small notes from your runs, including good plays, lucky saves, and decisions that were maybe not your finest work.

There are local scores and a Steam global leaderboard for score chasing.

What is included

  • Small arcade shoot ’em up action with quick restarts

  • A 10 sector main route, plus Overrun after you clear it

  • Enemy formations, bullet patterns, elites, tractor hazards, and boss tells

  • Bonus cores and powerups that can help a run or tempt you into trouble

  • Unlockable ships with different handling and weapons

  • Pilot ranks, career progress, Threat Codex discoveries, and run records

  • Local scores, Steam Achievements, Steam Cloud, and Steam global leaderboard support

  • Keyboard or controller input

Nova Swarm is not a huge game. It is a compact arcade shooter for players who enjoy learning patterns, chasing cleaner runs, and slowly turning panic into a plan.

store_data.about_the_game:
In Project Glowbound: Escape the darkness, you are cast into a mesmerizing world of shadow and machinery, taking control of a mysterious, glowing blue orb of pure energy. As the last remaining light source in a forgotten, labyrinthine ruin, your goal is simple yet daunting: navigate the dark and find a way out. However, the path ahead is far from clear.

This atmospheric physics-puzzler seamlessly blends precise platforming with clever environmental challenges. To survive, you must master the momentum and inertia of your radiant sphere, deftly maneuvering through narrow, hazard-filled corridors and dodging deadly obstacles like moving lasers and crushing pistons. But raw skill alone won't suffice; you will need to rely heavily on your wits. Ride. Panic. Deliver.

One moped. Four idiots. Zero chill.

Idiots 4 Order is a chaotic 2-4 player co-op delivery game where you and up to three friends share a single moped and somehow have to get food to hungry customers across a living, breathing city. Everyone has a role. Nobody agrees. Everything goes wrong.

  • Built for screaming at your friends — online co-op supported

store_data.about_the_game:
A Quiet Life in Restless Waters

A retired mage abandoned grand battles in search of a peaceful life by the sea. But something in the deep waters refuses to rest. In Lilac Wave, you must guide magical sea creatures, discover powerful spell synergies, and survive the exotic dangers that emerge from the ocean with each new day.

The Flow of Days: Preparation and Combat

The game follows a linear and strategic day-by-day rhythm, where each stage has a clear purpose for the evolution of your build:

  • Day 1: Activate the magical pool by pressing the mouse to unlock cards and choose your sea creature.

  • Day 2: Use the pool again to choose your first spell and start your strategy.

  • Day 3: Time for the test. Face a creature from the depths in automatic combat based on your previous choices.

  • Following Days (If Victorious): The cycle repeats more intensely. You will have consecutive magical pool days to acquire and accumulate spells, alternating with new combat days against greater threats.

  • The Final Showdown scraps: Advance through this planned cycle of preparation and battle until you reach the day of the main enemy: the great Boss.

Game Features

  • 100+ Different Enemies: Face a massive variety of exotic and mysterious sea creatures.

  • 100+ Unique Spells: Discover and select powerful magic to create the perfect synergy for your build.

  • 9 Types of Magical Creatures: Choose your starting companion through cards, each with unique characteristics.

  • Automated Tactical Combat: Build your strategy behind the scenes and watch the outcome of your choices unfold in battle.

  • Time-Based Roguelike Progression: Adapt your decisions day after day in runs shaped by your choices.

JamJamma 2: Gumgumma’s Trial delivers a challenging action experience in a 2D pixel-art platformer boss rush. After proving themselves worthy of earning their own Skull, JamJamma must return home, crossing hostile environments and encountering new creatures that test their combat skills. To make matters worse, GumGumma appears, seeking to stop them from returning and urging them to abandon the ways of their people.

The power of your enemy becomes your path

You will face one boss after another, with no regular enemies, and each victory grants you a new ability that unlocks fresh paths for exploration and access to new bosses, creating a cycle of ever-growing challenges until you reach the final boss behind this trial.

When you die, enjoy the scenery

(But if you’re a true maniac, push forward without dying.)

JamJamma 2 is not a roguelike, but a traditional experience with a beginning, middle, and end. New abilities, power-ups, and checkpoints will be your main tools throughout this solitary journey. We love challenging games — and newcomers to the genre will probably die a few times. As you return to the last checkpoint and retrace familiar territory or reconsider your choices through a new route, take a moment to appreciate the distinctive pixel-art environments. Frustration can be eased with a brief stroll through our forests, deserts, caves…

And if you’re a real Maniac, get ready for a mode with limited lives and no continues, where you must beat the game in a single run. Do you accept the challenge?

BAMMA! Philosophy: Anyone can be a Maniac

We are BAMMA!, a Brazilian studio passionate about challenging retro games, but accessibility lies at the heart of our game design philosophy. That’s why our slogan says: “Anyone can be a maniac!”

Alongside the more challenging mode, we also offer different features for players looking for a friendlier learning curve and a gateway into the genre, with options such as adjustable game speed, high-contrast mode, and more. Who knows — maybe this will be your first time overcoming a challenge you once thought was beyond your reach?

Highlights

  • Pixel art and animations crafted with care and dedication

  • An original soundtrack blending various rock genres with Brazilian inspirations

  • Retro-style action platformer boss rush focused on gameplay

  • Bosses with unique designs and environments created with passion

  • A straightforward experience with a clear beginning, middle, and end

  • Emergent storytelling that, in a simple and unobtrusive way, explores themes such as invasions, conflicts between tradition and modernity, belonging, and racial relations

  • Multiple game modes that provide intense challenges for maniacs while also offering an accessible entry point for players new to 2D action platformers

Unique Co-op Wheelchair Control

You share control between two players — one player controls the left side while the other controls the right side. Jump together, balance your movement, and try not to fall apart.

Obstacles

Work together through chaotic obstacles, dangerous jumps, and frustrating challenges where even the smallest mistake can send both of you back down.

Physics based Wheelchair

Master the physics-based wheelchair movement, time your double jumps perfectly, and test how strong your teamwork really is.

Multiplayer and Local Co-op

This is a co-op adventure for two players. You can play solo or together on the same device using different sides of the keyboard, or connect online from another device and play cooperatively. if you want to play solo, you are welcome.

Will your friendship survive the climb?

store_data.about_the_game:
The stars are hollow — but they aren't silent.

Great powers carve up the void. Convoys crawl across warp lanes. Pirate dens wait for a careless cargo. Hollow Stars is a strategy about the people who keep the economy alive: fleet captains, station managers, and the magnates who own whole empires.

This is a game of decisions, not reflexes. Hit tactical pause, dispatch fleets along trade routes, side with one faction against another — then watch the world keep living its own life.

What's inside

A living economy that doesn't cheat. Every price emerges from supply and demand. Every deposit is finite — mine it out and it's gone. Every NPC credit is real and going somewhere.

Up to four-player co-op, three modes. "Family" — one faction, shared wallet. "Allies" — separate empires in the same sector, trade and help one another. "Rivals" — open competition, whoever builds the network first wins.

Conservation of entities. Ships are built from ore and alloys. A destroyed ship becomes wreckage — loot it or recycle it. NPCs don't respawn.

NPC hierarchy. Without an Admiral, no full-scale war. Without a Diplomat, no alliances. Without a Magnate, no trade network. Heroes are found, hired, and kept.

Dozens of systems, factions with doctrine. The Military builds shipyards and capitals. Scientists unlock recipes. Traders crush rivals on price. Pirates live by raids and breed in neutral sectors.

Fog of war and private data. Every player sees a different galaxy. Your scout found an ore field — it's yours until a rival scout finds it too.

Clean top-down, readable iconography. Minimum visual noise, maximum information. No shooter gameplay — strategic decisions only.

Co-op

  • Multiplayer was on the table from day one. The lobby host picks a mode:

  • Family — one faction, shared wallet; ideal for a couple or parent-and-child.

  • Allies — separate factions with an alliance pact. Each player builds their own empire, but borders are open and resources flow directly between you.

  • Rivals — one sector, several competing players. Victory is economic (monopoly) or military (capital captured).

If a friend drops out, the world patiently waits for them to come back. Nobody gets kicked, nothing gets lost.

store_data.about_the_game:
Step into the world of luxury cars, where sales psychology and business strategy matter more than horsepower. In Supercar Dealer Simulator, you transform a small premium dealership into a massive automotive empire.

Grow your business in co-op mode! Form a cooperative with your friends and split tasks in real-time. While one person diagnoses and repairs machines in the workshop, another handles ruthless negotiations with a VIP client.

Instead of basic NPCs, you will face advanced artificial intelligence. Each buyer has a unique personality that reacts to your words, tone, and vehicle presentation. It all comes down to your team's intuition and negotiation style whether the client walks away empty-handed or signs the deal of a lifetime.

  • Build a Dealership Empire (Co-op & Multiplayer): Join forces with friends and build a powerful empire together. Take part in joint auctions against other players or collector clubs. Share operational tasks in real-time to maximize showroom profits.

  • Sales Psychology and AI Clients: Every client in the game has an individual personality, backstory, and specific purchasing motivations. You'll encounter Snobs who value prestige, Analysts focused on data, and Bargain Hunters looking for discounts. The AI system remembers past interactions, and clients' moods shift in real-time.

  • Servicing and Luxury Detailing: Some cars require more than just a sale. Demanding classic cars and supercars need diagnostics, tuning, repairs, and maintenance, which significantly increase their value and prestige.

  • Create Your Dream Garage: Invest your hard-earned money into your passion. Collect the rarest models, curate private collections, and display them in your luxury showroom. Rare cars are not just commodities—they are your trophies and long-term investments.

store_data.about_the_game:
Rabid Shift is a game where you take on the role of a doctor in a veterinary clinic. Your task is simple: admit patients, make diagnoses, and save lives. But an ordinary work shift quickly turns into a paranoid nightmare.

Sadists roam the streets, leaving horrific injuries on pets. The local detective demands your reports, the streets dictate their own rules, and the line between a doctor's duty and complicity blurs with each passing day.

  • Receive visitors. It’s not just caring pet owners who come to this clinic, but also those who would have been better left outside.

  • Search for clues. Use a hand flashlight for the initial examination. Find hidden injuries, fractures, and traces of horrific abuse. Every wound is a clue.

  • File reports. Analyze the perpetrator's signature and send your findings to the detective. A mistake in the report could cost someone their freedom, but the right answer might anger those who are deadly to cross.

  • Perform surgery. Take X-rays, set bones, and stitch up flesh. On the table lie a scalpel, a hammer, and needles—use them wisely.

  • Balance on the edge. The fate of the clinic and your own life depend on your decisions. Give in to blackmail or act according to your conscience? Your choices will lead to one of multiple endings.

Can you survive this job without losing your mind?

content_descriptors.notes:
The game contains scenes of violence, gore, and elements of body horror. There are detailed visual and textual descriptions of severe injuries to animals (lacerations, burns, open fractures, and head trauma). Gameplay involves surgical procedures using medical tools (scalpels, needles, and hammers), accompanied by the depiction of blood and exposed bones.
The plot explores dark and depressing themes, including animal abuse, psychological pressure, threats of physical violence, murder, and alcohol abuse. Certain endings feature elements of extreme body horror (mutations and illegal surgical experiments).

store_data.about_the_game:
You learned the rhyme when you were five.

The lab learned it too.

1 MONKEY LEFT is a physics-based cross-platform co-op

horror-comedy where five monkeys raid a decommissioned

research facility for the biggest payday of their lives —

while a nursery rhyme counts down the chaos.

Your job is simple:

Get in. Grab the high-value salvage. Reach the extraction

pod before the final verse plays.

Of course, nothing ever goes smoothly.

KEY FEATURES

🎵 The Rhyme Mechanic — Five verses. Eighteen minutes. Each

verse breaks the lab a little more, until the final one

triggers full purge protocol.

🌍 Full Cross-Platform Co-op — Five players, PC and console

in the same lobby. Squad up, lose your friends together.

🎤 Proximity Voice Chat — Scavenge, panic, shout warnings,

and listen to your crewmates scream from somewhere deep in

the nursery dark.

📦 Physics-Based Salvage — Rip machinery from walls. Drag

oversized loot through tight corridors. Decide what's worth

carrying — and what's about to get someone hurt.

⚡ Strategic Chaos — Manage your noise, your weight, your

nerves, and the rhyme itself. The lab keeps count.

But whatever you do, don't lose focus — because the rhyme

is older than you, and the lab knows every verse.

Five monkeys. Five verses. One nursery rhyme that's been

waiting.

Find out which verse takes you.

store_data.about_the_game:
Investigate the World's Most Famous Mystery

Legend of Loch Ness is a first-person open-world mystery exploration and investigation game set on the legendary waters of Loch Ness and the Scottish Highlands.

Explore a vast recreation of Loch Ness as you track sightings, gather evidence, photograph unexplained phenomena, deploy scientific equipment, and uncover secrets hidden beneath the loch's dark waters. Travel freely across the loch by boat, motorcycle, and on foot while investigating one of the world's most enduring mysteries.

But discovering the truth is only one option.

Develop photographs in your darkroom, analyse evidence, build your reputation as an investigator, or exploit the world's fascination with Nessie through carefully crafted hoaxes. Create convincing evidence, attract media attention, and turn myth into profit - if you can avoid being exposed.

Whether you pursue science, deception, or something in between, every decision influences your reputation, relationships, and the future of the McCray family business.

A Legacy Left Behind

Stay together. Stay quiet. Go deeper.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Square Computer. There are no redundant instruction sets, no bloated stacks of code—only the purest flow of space, time, and information. Within this terminal-styled grid space, you will guide, refract, filter, and split streams of flowing particles using blocks with distinct computational logic. As information from input sources ripples through your precisely laid arrays and perfectly mutates into definite outputs at the terminus, you will bear witness to the emergence of rationality with your own hands.

Components of Order

The game features dozens of logic blocks. Each performs its dedicated duty, enabling you to assemble sophisticated computational pipelines.

Feedback & Loops 

Bid farewell to traditional static puzzles. Introduce logic blocks and unique data path delays to make particles cycle continuously. Harness this "hardware-level latency" and precise timing to bring any conceived logic into reality.

Intuitive Logic Execution

Powered by the physical motion of "logic bits," the system possesses native hardware-level delay. You can clearly observe blocks firing in sequence and data settling step-by-step, fully immersing yourself in the purest sense of problem-solving achievement.

store_data.about_the_game:
Friendly Fire is a bullet hell survivor with a twist.

You'll need to survive 20 minutes against waves of enemies — but your

greatest threat might be your own weapons.

You can choose from many turrets, each with different strengths. The

stronger the weapon, the bigger the danger to yourself. Your turrets

don't care who they hit — every bullet that lands on you deals damage.

Your only ways to survive: movement, dash, and a shield with limited

durability.

────────────────

[Core Mechanics]

• Your turrets are double-edged — every bullet can hurt you

• Shield system — block and reflect friendly fire, with bonus

damage on deflected shots

• Dash through bullet hell — invincible while dashing

• Stronger weapons = greater self-damage risk

[Content]

• 24 turrets in EA — machine gun, sniper, shotgun, mortar, laser,

homing missile, flamethrower, black hole, sawblade, mine, gatling,

spike trap, echo, parasite shot, railgun, volley, harpoon, plasma,

tuning fork, catapult, drill, caltrop, burning ground, boomerang

• 22 turret upgrades — crit, pierce, ricochet, burn, freeze,

execute, overheat mode, and more

• 50+ player perks — death totem, lifeline, golden time, chain hit,

violent reflection, orbital shield, and more

• 11 enemy types — tanks, swarms, chargers, splitters, suicide

bombers, summoners, and more

• 5 characters — Average Joe, Live Round Purist, Laser Purist,

AoE Specialist, Defensive Build — each with unique bonuses and penalties

• 21 meta upgrades — convert kills into permanent boosts: health,

armor, weapon damage, enemy count, and more

• 3 difficulties — Easy / Normal / Hard

────────────────

[Endless Mode]

• After surviving 20 minutes, choose to continue the challenge

• Enemy HP and damage caps removed — push your skills to the limit

────────────────

[Supported Languages]

• English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese,

Korean, French, German, Spanish (Spain), Italian,

Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Polish

I have designed this experience to annihilate the downtime of the genre. In the Krasniy-Zavod sector, there are no gas rings, absurd waiting times, or endless walks where nothing happens; here, you land shooting from the very first second in an ultra-high-density battlefield that wants you dead. Every tactical threat is active the moment you touch the ground, forcing you to dodge heavy artillery and enemy drones in a frantic hardcore combat experience where danger is real every five seconds.

I have eliminated any artifice to deliver the purest and most brutal form of immersive, fast, and intense tactical combat. Every mechanic has been created and focused on offering you unprecedented immersion, where precision and realism are the only pillars that hold up the battlefield.

HIGH-INTENSITY TACTICAL HELMET CAM COMBAT

OPERATOR UNIFORMS: 100% MILITARY AND TACTICAL SKINS

All my uniforms, both for male and female operators, strictly comply with authentic combat standards. In Iron Offensive, I provide no room for arcade designs or out-of-place colors; every skin is real military gear designed to integrate perfectly into the combat environment. The female operators also use 100% military uniforms within the game, with no absurd colors, as I maintain an absolute tactical equipment standard for everyone.

MAXIMUM COOPERATION: FPV KAMIKAZE DRONES, RAPTORS, UGVs, AND HIMARS-STYLE ARTILLERY

The game completely changes its mechanical rules whether you play solo or deploy in a squad of up to four friends. Iron Offensive introduces dynamic tactical roles based on real military hardware tools, allowing players to take control of advanced technology in the middle of combat.

Tactical Deployment and Arsenal Control: On the battlefield, you are not limited to foot infantry. You can pilot heavy armor directly on the ground, coordinate destructive attacks by calling in HIMARS-style heavy artillery fire, or deploy FPV kamikaze drones and Raptor recon drones to decimate enemy positions from the air.

Mobile Support Operator and UGV Control: If you play as a team, one squad member can equip and deploy an unmanned ground vehicle (UGV) drone modified with a logistics cargo basket. This device becomes a mobile resupply point in the middle of the firefight. As long as the team protects the ground drone and the teammate operating it, any soldier who stays close to the UGV basket will receive continuous ammo resupplies. Ran out of RPG rockets in the middle of an assault on an enemy BTR? Don't go looking for boxes around the map: take cover next to your teammate's ground drone, reload your heavy weaponry instantly, and open fire again. Hardcore cooperation at an arcade pace.

WEIGHT MANAGEMENT AND ADVANCED REAL-TIME BALLISTICS

Before launching into the raid, you decide the price of your power. In the armory, you can configure your loadout using standard issue gear, unlocks, or items bought with your COPS. Choose your primary weapon, secondary, a third slot dedicated to anti-tank weaponry (bazookas), and the drone type with its payload (C4, kamikaze, etc.). You can customize zoom sights, add armor plates to your vest, or upgrade your ammo quality to armor-piercing rounds.

The Law of Physics on the Frontline: Every decision in the menus has a direct impact on the gameplay loop. The more geared and armored you drop into the battlefield, the heavier your operator will be, increasing your combat fatigue. If you decide to go light—for example, only with your primary weapon, no secondary, no bazooka, and no drones—you will move at extreme speed, sprint faster, and take much longer to tire out. You decide whether to play as a human tank or a lightning-fast ghost.

In-Game Weapon Modification Without Pauses: Adaptation in the midst of chaos is immediate. If the situation changes during the match, you don't need to exit or wait to respawn. Press a button, open your weapon's interactive menu in real-time right on the field, and modify its components with a couple of quick clicks: swap ammo types on the fly to armor-piercing, or instantly toggle between your unlocked sights to switch from a long-range zoom to a short-range quick target acquisition. The frontline changes in seconds; so does your weaponry.

Simplified Ammo Logistics: In Iron Offensive, you don't come to count bullets in a boring way. Weapons have unlimited standard ammo on the frontline at no base cost; your operational capital is invested in paying to upgrade the caliber quality and the projectiles you load into your rifles, bazookas, drones, or armor.

A DYNAMIC AND LIVING MAP

All objectives operate simultaneously. Whether you want to focus on high-intensity combat, sabotage enemy assets, or hunt for intel, the choice is yours. The environment is persistent: if you secure technical blueprints today, the map will dynamically update for your next raid, forcing you to find the physical components to complete the cycle. Central Command knows 90% of what happens in the sector. The remaining 10% consists of hidden objectives and high-value secrets that will never appear on your HUD until you physically interact with them. Finding these secrets is the key to obtaining the highest economic rewards.

PHOTOREALISM AND COMBAT FATIGUE

The perspective reacts through a physical fatigue model. Explosions crack your helmet cam lens, and the signal flickers under suppressive fire. I have merged the best of the genre: speed, intensity, and tactical difficulty in a dynamic battlefield full of bombs, artillery, and gunfire everywhere (which constantly slow you down and make everything harder), combined with raw physical consequences like combat fatigue and blurred vision when a hit lands. Aiming, shooting, and overall movement are fast, but real exhaustion will affect your senses in this continuous combat hell. It's an uncompromising tactical experience where every bullet counts.

INDOORS VS. OUTDOORS: THE HUNT FOR ELITE GEAR

The intensity of the battle changes radically depending on your position. While the outdoors is a chaos of AI artillery fire, tracers, enemy drones, and constant pressure, buildings offer a completely different kind of tension. Inside the structures, open warfare stops to make room for tactical terror. Among automated mines and traps, you will find the most powerful equipment, such as bazookas and heavy weaponry.

USE OR GEOLOCATE WITH GPS LOCK

When you find superior gear or tactical intel, you face a critical decision: use it immediately to survive or mark it for the future. You have the ability to GPS-lock the items you find; by locking them, you secure that information in your navigation system. If you decide to extract it, you must use your GPS to geolocate the object and send the coordinates to Central Command. After a successful mission, a recovery drone will pick up the marked equipment to secure it in your permanent arsenal.

PROGRESSION, COPS ECONOMY, AND PILOTING LICENSES

Your success on the field translates into immediate operational capital. Completing objectives and taking down enemies grants you the in-game currency called COPS. Use your earnings to expand your jurisdiction, buying access to new industrial sectors and larger areas of the map. Progression allows you to acquire tactical accreditation cards and buy piloting contracts. All heavy vehicles (like Leopard, Abrams, Bradley series tanks, or BTRs) scattered neutrally across the battlefield from the start of the match will strictly require you to have previously purchased or extracted these piloting licenses to be used; otherwise, you won't be able to start them.

KILLSTREAKS AND THE TACTICAL IMMUNITY BREATHER

In this hell of crossfire, achieving killstreaks gives you the opportunity to deploy powerful remote-controlled tactical assets depending on the operator you choose. By chaining 7 to 8 enemy kills, you can activate drones or UGVs that will give you a crucial breather of up to 5 minutes. When deploying this ground drone, it crouches and moves super fast through narrow areas and chokepoints to gather intel and hack data in total peace. While you control these devices remotely, your human operator is physically protected in a bunker or armored room out of danger: the AI cannot kill you during this use, offering you a mental break to relax before returning to foot infantry.

THE EXTRACTION PROTOCOL: DYNAMIC TP-LINK SYSTEM

Extraction is not a static defense; it's a battle for data. To finish the mission and secure your gathered intel, your COPS, and the geolocated gear you GPS-locked, you must master the sector's shifting signal.

Mobile Intel Zones: Intel collection points are dynamic. These TP-Link zones relocate every five or six minutes, forcing you to maintain tactical movement and reposition your squad to stay connected. You can extract data on the move thanks to the GPS you carry: if you enter the radius of a TP-Link mounted on a tank or BTR, the vehicle will serve as a mobile shield against the AI's artillery fatigue while you perform the extraction without stopping.

The Final Link and the 50-Meter Rule: As the mission reaches its climax, the mobile zones disappear, leaving a single final antenna for extraction. To transmit the data and consolidate the victory of everything you locked, you must strictly be within the 50 to 100-meter radius of this last safe extraction zone when the match timer hits zero.

OPERATIONAL MISSION TIMER AND 5-SECOND RESPAWN

Time is your only judge. Each raid has an operational window of 20 to 40 minutes to complete objectives and transmit data. This is a session limit per match, not a product access restriction. In this game, completing objectives and fighting constantly is crucial. Falling in combat is not the end; thanks to the rapid respawn system, you will drop back in just five seconds to rejoin the fight. If you get killed with one minute left in the match and you were in the final radius, you will respawn in 5 seconds and have just enough time to make an agonizing sprint back to the extraction radius to save your loot. Furthermore, on the respawn screen, if you earned a tank via killstreak and it's available on the map, you can click it to respawn directly mounted on its tracks instantly. You only lose the mission and your belongings if the match clock runs out completely and you failed to be inside the final extraction radius.

EXTREME TACTICAL OPTIMIZATION

I have extremely optimized Iron Offensive to achieve terminal photorealism without the need for a supercomputer. Deploy in EPIC quality (50% 3D resolution) with absolute combat fluidity. The base tactical requirement only demands an AMD Ryzen 5 2600, 16 GB of RAM, and a GTX 1650 (4 GB). My shielded system guarantees that every frame serves the action, opening the battlefield to millions of players discarded by poorly optimized releases.

store_data.about_the_game:
You begin with calluses, not a crown.

Idle Crown is a medieval idle RPG with no energy bars, no premium currency,
and no real-world clock between you and the next level. Just fifteen
skills, a Holding you raise stone by stone, and an XP curve built for the
long haul.

Fifteen skills, deep progression


  • Chop pine to heartwood, mine tin to runite, forge bronze swords through sovereign-tier blades.
  • Fish minnows to leviathans, hunt rabbits to drakes, cook simple meals into royal feasts.
  • Combat, Piety, and Stewardship round out the lord's craft, each with passives that bend every other skill.

Early levels move quick. The endgame is measured in days. Past 99, Mastery
branches (Yield, Pace, Fortune) open for every skill,
fully respec-able.

Raise a Holding


Twelve buildings on a 20×20 plot, each granting permanent speed bonuses.
Upgrade tiers climb from pine planks to voidstone. A maxed Holding is
months of work. A centerpiece you can point at when someone asks what
you've been doing all winter.

Workers in parallel


Climb the rank ladder (Serf → Freeman → Yeoman → King) to unlock
workers who run skills beside you. At high ranks they outpace the lord
himself.

23 permanent upgrades


Sink coin into yield, speed, XP, crit, coin gain, minion slots, forge
efficiency, sell prices, boss cooldowns, and more. Each ranks up the
deeper you invest. Push the offline cap from 12 hours to 36. Slot a fifth
minion. A treasury that always has a reason to grow.

100 achievements, written like a chronicle


Every achievement is named and written in voice, with no dry "kill 100 X"
copy. Hidden achievements stay hidden until earned. Each ships with a
hand-rendered gold-on-parchment icon.

Built for Steam


  • 39 leaderboards: speedrun, per-skill XP, Mastery, lifetime XP, longest streak
  • Local saves with five rolling backups, plus full JSON import/export
  • Friend Rich Presence so your liege can see what skill you're grinding
  • Offline catchup up to 36 hours, so a workday doesn't wipe a play-day

Serf to Sovereign. Take your time. The throne is patient.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Hades always seemed like someone who controlled everything within his realm. But Persephone’s illness reveals that even the ruler of the underworld can become helpless when faced with the fear of losing a loved one. He turns to the Argonauts Agency, and Jason and Medea set out on a journey beneath the earth.

There, the heroes discover that Persephone’s condition is tied to troubles that have disrupted life throughout the underworld. To save her, they must overcome trials, uncover hidden secrets, and restore the lost balance. When Persephone finally recovers, the gloomy realm once again becomes a home where Hades and his wife can live in peace.

Argonauts Agency is a classic time-management game with worker assignment: on each level you quickly gather resources (food, wood, etc.), build and upgrade structures (farm, sawmill, quarry,, etc.), clear obstacles, and manage to complete the objectives for ‘3 stars’ before the timer runs out, using temporary boosts (speed-up, time stop, construction speed-up).

Game Features:

  • A brand-new adventure for Jason and Medea in the underworld.

  • A touching story about Hades’ devotion and Persephone’s illness.

  • A dark, atmospheric setting filled with secrets and ancient power.

  • An immersive soundtrack draws players into the mysterious underworld.

  • Elegant underground pathways create the feeling of an ancient labyrinth.

  • Dynamic comic-style cutscenes bring key events to life with drama, action, and emotion."
store_data.detailed_description:
"Hades always seemed like someone who controlled everything within his realm. But Persephone’s illness reveals that even the ruler of the underworld can become helpless when faced with the fear of losing a loved one. He turns to the Argonauts Agency, and Jason and Medea set out on a journey beneath the earth.

There, the heroes discover that Persephone’s condition is tied to troubles that have disrupted life throughout the underworld. To save her, they must overcome trials, uncover hidden secrets, and restore the lost balance. When Persephone finally recovers, the gloomy realm once again becomes a home where Hades and his wife can live in peace.

Argonauts Agency is a classic time-management game with worker assignment: on each level you quickly gather resources (food, wood, etc.), build and upgrade structures (farm, sawmill, quarry,, etc.), clear obstacles, and manage to complete the objectives for ‘3 stars’ before the timer runs out, using temporary boosts (speed-up, time stop, construction speed-up).

Game Features:

  • A brand-new adventure for Jason and Medea in the underworld.

  • A dark, atmospheric setting filled with secrets and ancient power.

  • An immersive soundtrack draws players into the mysterious underworld.

  • Elegant underground pathways create the feeling of an ancient labyrinth.

store_data.about_the_game:
Step into frozen moments in time and piece together the truth. All Possible Suspects is a point-and-click deduction game of observation and logic, where you must analyze intricate, static scenes to reconstruct a series of diverse and unusual occurrences.

All the keywords you need are already provided. Your task is to use reason, observation, and logical deduction to arrange them correctly and solve the mystery.

How It Works

Every scenario is a logic puzzle captured in a single, motionless instant.
  • Observe the Scene: Look closely at characters, items, and the environment to understand the context of what just happened.
  • Analyze the Clues: Gather information from the frozen moment to figure out the relationships, motives, and sequence of events.
  • Fill in the Blanks: Use the provided list of keywords to complete the sentences in your notebook, successfully reconstructing the narrative of the event.

Key Features

  • Diverse Scenarios: Explore a wide variety of unique situations, strange anomalies, and intricate puzzles that go far beyond standard crime scenes.
  • Pure Deductive Logic: With the keywords already provided, your success depends entirely on your ability to observe, reason, and make connections.
  • Interactive Thinking Grid: Slot the correct words into your notebook to answer the crucial questions of who, what, how, and why.
  • Play at Your Own Pace: There are no timers or quick-time events. Take your time to study the details, formulate your theories, and solve each puzzle at your own speed.

store_data.about_the_game:
We took the deckbuilder roguelite and split every card in half. In Trait, each card carries two effects - swipe left for one, swipe right for the other. Block or attack. Buff yourself or burn the enemy. There's no wrong answer, but there's always a better one, and you have to figure out which.

Build a deck that plays to your instincts. Every card you pick up reshapes what the next swipe means — stack Burn effects for slow-cook damage, layer shields and Thorns for a reactive fortress, or go all-in on raw Strength and hope nothing hits back.

Monsters don't just stand there. Slimes buff themselves every turn. Skeletons cycle between attacks and debuffs. Mimics start stuffing curse cards into your deck.

Between fights, upgrade your cards at rest sites or pick new ones from reward pools. Every upgrade tips the scales: your Spark now applies double Thorns, your Inferno consumes all your Burn stacks and converts them into a single devastating hit. Small numbers become big numbers. That's the fun part.

Features

  • Two Traits, One Card - Every card has a left swipe and a right swipe. The direction you choose defines your strategy, and no two runs play the same way twice.

  • A Deck That Grows With You - Start with a basic set of cards and add new ones after each fight. Upgrade them at rest sites to push their numbers further or unlock stronger versions of their effects.

  • Monsters That Fight Back - Slimes that buff, burn, shield, explode, and reflect damage. Bats that heal off your pain. Rats that turtle behind armor. Skeletons that debuff you before the big swing. Losts of creatures, lots of strategies.

  • Status Effects That Stack - Burn, Thorns, Vulnerable, Surge, Wildfire, Iron Skin - layer buffs and debuffs to create combos that snowball across a fight. Every effect interacts with the damage pipeline, so a well-timed debuff can double your output.

  • Intent-Driven Combat - See what every enemy plans to do before they do it. Read the board, weigh your options, and commit to the swipe. No hidden information, just pressure.

  • Roguelite Runs Through a Shifting Dungeon - Stages of weighted encounters mean every run shuffles the lineup. The same deck won't carry you twice.

Current Build Status:

Promo Wrestling World is launching in Early Access. The current review build is v0.9.0-beta.1, a playable Early Access beta that includes the core promotion management loop, booking, roster management, rival companies, titles, storylines, simulation systems, and long-save progression.

This is not the final 1.0 version. Expect balance changes, UI polish, bug fixes, and feature expansion during Early Access.

Promo Wrestling World is a deep wrestling management simulation about booking shows, building stars, managing money, and surviving in a living wrestling industry.

Take control of a promotion and run the business week by week. Book matches, shape storylines, manage contracts, track morale, handle injuries, build championships, and watch rival companies fight for the same audience and talent.

Key Features

• Book weekly TV, major events, matches, promos, angles, vignettes, and story beats.

• Manage a roster of wrestlers with popularity, morale, fatigue, ego, contracts, chemistry, and push status.

• Build long-running storylines with heat, momentum, rivalries, stables, betrayals, and title chases.

• Track championships with prestige, reign histories, defenses, vacancies, and title lineages.

• Run the business side: cash, wages, sponsors, TV deals, PPV strategy, venues, production costs, and market pressure.

• Compete against rival promotions that run shows, bid on talent, grow, fold, and reshape the wrestling world.

• Follow your dynasty through milestones, awards, Hall of Fame candidates, legacy score, and long-term history.

• Edit the world directly with the World Editor: promotions, workers, titles, regions, venues, teams, relationships, match    types, media formats, and more.

• Start in different eras with era-specific economics, fan expectations, media formats, and industry flavor.

• Watch new promotions emerge during long saves with founders, colors, logos, rosters, finances, ambition, and their own histories.

Current Build Status:

Promo Wrestling World is launching in Early Access. The current review build is v0.9.0-beta.1, a playable Early Access beta that includes the core promotion management loop, booking, roster management, rival companies, titles, storylines, simulation systems, and long-save progression.

This is not the final 1.0 version. Expect balance changes, UI polish, bug fixes, and feature expansion during Early Access.

Promo Wrestling World is a deep wrestling management simulation about booking shows, building stars, managing money, and surviving in a living wrestling industry.

Take control of a promotion and run the business week by week. Book matches, shape storylines, manage contracts, track morale, handle injuries, build championships, and watch rival companies fight for the same audience and talent.

Key Features

• Book weekly TV, major events, matches, promos, angles, vignettes, and story beats.

• Manage a roster of wrestlers with popularity, morale, fatigue, ego, contracts, chemistry, and push status.

• Build long-running storylines with heat, momentum, rivalries, stables, betrayals, and title chases.

• Track championships with prestige, reign histories, defenses, vacancies, and title lineages.

• Run the business side: cash, wages, sponsors, TV deals, PPV strategy, venues, production costs, and market pressure.

• Compete against rival promotions that run shows, bid on talent, grow, fold, and reshape the wrestling world.

• Follow your dynasty through milestones, awards, Hall of Fame candidates, legacy score, and long-term history.

• Edit the world directly with the World Editor: promotions, workers, titles, regions, venues, teams, relationships, match    types, media formats, and more.

• Start in different eras with era-specific economics, fan expectations, media formats, and industry flavor.

• Watch new promotions emerge during long saves with founders, colors, logos, rosters, finances, ambition, and their own histories.

Early Access Focus

Promo Wrestling World is already playable as a full single-player management sandbox, but it is still growing. Early Access will focus on balance, usability, long-save stability, better onboarding, expanded world simulation, deeper booking tools, and community-requested improvements.

If you enjoy dense management games, long-term saves, wrestling booking, business pressure, and watching a fictional sports-entertainment world evolve over time, Promo Wrestling World is built for you.

store_data.about_the_game:
Awakening in the Dark

When you open your eyes, you remember neither your name nor how you got here. There is only one thing you know: this is a cold, eerie, and dark basement where every corner is shaped by agony. The smell of rust and blood in the air is the only remaining evidence of the horrific tortures you endured. Your mind has completely shut itself down to block out the trauma you experienced.

Time is Running Out, Obey the Rules

Escaping this basement won't be easy. To unlock the doors, activate rusty mechanisms, and survive, you must interact with every object around you and push through the escape routes. But beware; every step you take, every sound you make, draws his attention.

Gameplay

In this claustrophobic survival horror game, players must survive the deadly traps set by the psychopath who kidnapped them and find a way out of this underground dungeon. Escaping from here will not be easy; you must interact with every object around you to unlock doors and activate rusty mechanisms, and crawl through narrow ventilation shafts in search of an exit.

Key Features

  • Single-Player Psychological Horror

Fear not only the darkness, but also the mind games your own sanity plays on you, and face that unknown monstrosity that could appear behind you at any moment.

  • Collect Memory Fragments

Piece together who you are and the dark secrets of your past by finding cryptic notes and clues scattered around.

  • Deadly Environmental Puzzles

Increase your chances of survival by solving complex mechanisms, lightbulbs, and buttons in the torture rooms with the right logic.

  • Immersive Tension and Atmosphere

Feel the suffocating despair of the basement to your very bones with narrow ventilation shafts, rusty doors, and dim lighting.

From the makers of Football Coach: College Dynasty comes an all-new pro experience.

Pro Football Dynasty is an upcoming pro football management game, providing a deep yet accessible dynasty experience. Build your legacy as a coach, calling plays and gameplanning, or as GM, making deals and managing the cap. Featuring everything you love about pro football, and deep customizability to play the way you want.

FEATURES:

  • Build your roster through the draft, free agency, and trades, scouting prospects and outmaneuvering 31 rival GMs

  • Level up your team staff, with unique skills and personalities so no two hires are the same

  • Play your way with tons of different settings to change, including injuries, free agency rules, draft rules, salary cap, and more

Game day or draft day, Pro Football Dynasty puts the weight of the franchise in your hands.

store_data.about_the_game:
A weekend getaway. A harmless treasure hunt. A desperate rescue mission.

You arrive at the dense, suffocating edge of the woods expecting a cheerful reunion with your girlfriend, Steph, who went missing during a girls' weekend trip. Instead, you find an abandoned campsite, scattered gear, and a trail of frantic notes.

The "treasure hunt" Steph and her friends were following wasn't a game at all. It was a trap.

They unlocked something ancient. Now, they are trapped in a living nightmare, and the clock is ticking. To save Steph and escape with your lives, you must piece together the clues of a ritual gone horribly wrong.

The rules of the forest are simple but cruel: Gather the stolen gems. Return them to the cursed, gold-laden coffin. Or become a permanent part of the woods.

Key Features

  • Atmospheric Psychological Horror: Explore a beautifully eerie, Unreal Engine-powered forest where the shadows stretch and every snapping twig could mean your demise.

  • Piecing Together the Mystery: Discover letters, and your own characters audio/narrative to reconstruct the final hours of the girls' weekend and find Steph’s location.

  • High-Stakes Relic Hunting: Track down the scattered gems hidden across haunted landmarks, all while keeping your wits about you when you first hear the creatures.

  • The Cursed Coffin: Your only safe haven—and your ultimate objective. Get the 8 gems that are scattered around the forest and escape. 

  • Immersive Survival: No heavy weaponry, just your wits, a flashlight, and the desperate drive to save the woman you love.

Will you break the curse, or will you take their place in the coffin?

store_data.about_the_game:
Raise dinosaurs. Fulfill orders. Survive your coworkers.

Overhatched is a chaotic 1–4 player local & online co-op management party game where you and your team hatch, raise, and sell dinosaurs from increasingly ridiculous production facilities.
Think fast, work together, and try not to destroy your operation in the process.
Every facility becomes a frantic balancing act of physical inventory management, fishing, farming, feeding, logistics, and teamwork gone horribly wrong.
One missed task can send the whole operation spiraling.

HATCH. RAISE. SELL.

Build your dinosaur business from the ground up.
Order supplies, hatch eggs, raise dinosaurs to maturity, fulfill customer orders, and load completed shipments onto the truck before time runs out.
But raising dinosaurs isn't easy.
Different species require entirely different production chains:
🦕 Herbivores need crops you must grow and maintain.
🦖 Carnivores require livestock breeding and meat processing.
🐟 Piscivores demand freshly caught fish that must be cleaned and prepared.
Every dinosaur is another logistical problem waiting to happen.

MANAGE YOUR FACILITY

Each level is a fully operational dinosaur facility located in unique environments ranging from farmers markets to crowded city warehouses to remote island operations.
Use your facility's:
- Supply ordering computer
- Receiving docks
- Shipping bays
- Forklifts
- Crop plots
- Fishing docks
- Incubators
- Nurserys
- Livestock pens
- Processing stations
Everything arrives on large pallets, forcing you to manage valuable floor space while keeping supplies accessible and production flowing.
Or... you know... pile everything in the middle and regret it later.

store_data.about_the_game:
Operation Scoville is a twin-stick shooter, tower defense, roguelike. Rutabaga III, the leader of the Vegetable Rebellion has assigned you to a covert solo operation. Play as Habanero Jr. and protect gardens across the world from the human warmongers. Although you're going in solo, you'll have the help of many traps and power ups to defeat the evil humans.

Enemies:

Fight a variety of different enemies with their own behaviors:

Soldier | Shotgunner | Ninja | Bomber | Saboteur | Machinegunner

Towers:

Make use of several different traps and towers to help you in your fight:

Barbed Wire | Road Block | Landmine | Bear Trap | Gas Canister | Shotgun Turret | Machinegun Turret | Mortar

Defeat every wave of enemies in a level without running out of life in your garden to advance to the next level. Between levels, you may purchase upgrades and traps with money you've gained in battle. Now that you've seen your competition, and your tools, let's hope you can fend off the human onslaught.

Isle Of Nexaryth

Step into a dangerous fantasy world filled with ancient creatures, powerful bosses, and hidden secrets.

Isle Of Nexaryth is an open-world fantasy adventure where players experience survival, exploration, and progression through the eyes of a young dragon struggling to survive in the brutal lands of Nexaryth Island.

Begin your journey as a small and vulnerable dragon, then grow stronger by hunting creatures, exploring mysterious regions, and overcoming deadly threats spread across the island. Discover ancient ruins, dark caves, forgotten lands, dense forests, and dangerous territories hiding secrets deep within the world.

As you progress, you will level up, face stronger enemies, and prepare yourself for massive boss battles. Each boss features unique attack patterns, combat mechanics, and battle environments that will test your strength and survival skills.

The island of Nexaryth is divided into multiple dangerous regions, each with its own atmosphere, wildlife, enemies, and mysteries to uncover. Exploration plays a major role in the experience, rewarding players who venture into hidden and dangerous areas.

  • Open-world dragon adventure

  • Play as a young dragon struggling to survive

  • Large-scale boss battles

  • Creature hunting and progression system

  • Leveling and combat system

  • Exploration-focused gameplay

  • Fantasy environments and atmospheric world design

  • Ancient ruins, caves, and hidden locations

  • Multiple dangerous regions to explore

  • Progression-based gameplay experience

  • Single-player fantasy adventure

Dark Eyes: Super Soldier 2 returns to the Dark Eyes universe, continuing the story of the Super Soldier and his fight for humanity's survival.

After the events of the first game, the war is far from over. The Dark Eyes — known as the Delma — have returned, stronger and more dangerous than ever. Standing above them is the Alpha, an elite Dark Eyes commander whose presence threatens the future of Earth itself.

But the enemy isn't the only battle ahead.

The Super Soldier continues to struggle with the consequences of the Super Soldier Program. store_data.about_the_game:
Collect Honey and Grow Your Hive

Control a single bee and collect honey and pollen from flowers.

Bring the honey back to your hive. Pollen becomes experience points.

Your goal is to collect as much honey as possible within the time limit.

Level Up with Pollen and Strengthen Your Bee with Cards

Collect pollen to level up.
Choose one card from a set of three and strengthen your bee’s abilities.
Improve movement speed, gathering speed, carrying capacity, flower rewards, and more to create your own playstyle.

Unlock Skills with Honey

The honey you collect is both your score and a resource for future growth.
After each run, use honey to unlock skills, strengthen your bees and hive, and prepare for your next challenge.

Unlock New Bees with Pollen

Collected pollen can also be used to unlock new bees.

Each bee has different abilities, allowing you to enjoy the game with a variety of playstyles.

Pollen can also be used to unlock new maps.

From Manual Gathering to an Automated Swarm

At first, you gather honey alone as a single bee.
But as you unlock skills, worker bees will begin helping you gather automatically.
Enjoy the sense of growth as your swarm expands and your hive becomes more and more lively.

store_data.about_the_game:
Get lost on purpose.

Blissflow is a first person journey through infinite procedural architecture. Dash through neon corridors, navigate towering mazes, and hunt glowing orbs across dreamscapes that never generate the same layout twice.

Every run builds a unique world from fluorescent halls, flooded liminal corridors, and vast geometric voids. Whether you're chasing flow state or just drifting, the architecture keeps shifting around you.

THREE MODES OF DRIFT

Flow — Momentum-driven vertical navigation. Dash, slide, and freerun through towers of abstract geometry. Chase wandering orbs across platforms that stretch into the sky.

Maze — Procedural labyrinths that grow larger and stranger as you progress. Navigate shifting architectural styles, from clean minimalist corridors to crystalline, organic caves.

Labyrinth — Atmospheric orb hunts through sprawling, interconnected chambers. Navigate by instinct through fog, color, and sound.

THE PILGRIMAGE

String your runs together into a roguelite journey. Choose your path between modes, manage your lives, and push deeper as the architecture evolves. Difficulty scales with you. Save and resume anytime.

NOT ALL DREAMS ARE PEACEFUL

Wandering Sentinels occupy select areas, adding a rhythmic layer of tension to your navigation. Outmaneuver them or leave them behind.

YOUR PACE

Toggle Zen Mode at any time to remove all hazards. Blissflow adapts to how you want to play, focused traversal or pure ambient exploration.

store_data.about_the_game:
Born from the acclaimed mobile hit Trail of Gods: The Cursed Island, this PC edition expands the experience for players who fell in love with its brutal combat, haunting 1-bit aesthetic, and cursed world.

Originally released on mobile and praised for delivering a compact Souls-inspired adventure unlike anything else on the platform, Trail of Gods now arrives on Steam with the same relentless spirit, rebuilt for a bigger screen and a new generation of explorers.

The Gods Are Gone

They didn't die. They left, and whatever held the world together left with them. What remains is crumbling castles, poisoned land, and the people too stubborn or too broken to follow. You wake up in the middle of it with nothing.

Trail of Gods is a pocket-sized action role-playing game. Play it for five minutes or get lost in this small world for hours.

One Button

Everything you do in a fight comes from a single button. Press it to block. Hold it to charge. Let go to strike. How long you hold and which way you release decides what happens: a quick tap blocks, a short hold is a light attack, a long hold is a heavy one, and a fast flick rolls you out of danger.

Block at the right moment, then strike back instantly to counter. The window is tight. Learn it or die learning it.

Every Gram Counts

Your equipment has real weight, and it changes everything. A full suit of knight armor keeps you alive but slows you down. Torn clothes and a sharp dagger leave you open but fast. What you carry decides how quickly you walk, run, roll, and swing.

Heavy gear has its own trick: carry more than 5 kg and rolling into an enemy deals damage. Your dodge becomes a weapon.

Take What You Find

Find different ways to fight with, and fight your way through with strong and heavy gear or light fast and fragile stealth-mode.

You're not alone out here. Mercenaries wander the world. Hire them for free. They fight at your side and they don't ask questions.

Features

  • Minimalistic visuals

  • Single-button combat built entirely on timing and positioning

  • Weight system that ties your gear to your speed and playstyle

  • Several weapon classes with distinct animations and feel

  • Several gear sets with defense, weight, and charisma stats

  • Charisma system that changes how the world treats you

  • Hire mercenaries to fight at your side

  • Supports mouse + keyboard and gamepad

  • Small enough for a break. Deep enough to stay

store_data.about_the_game:
LAST ZONE is a brutal co-op survival game set in a post-Soviet world.

The world has fallen into chaos, where every step is a fight for survival. You will face hordes of mutants, ruthless factions, and constant resource shortages. Team up with friends to turn ruins into an impregnable fortress, craft equipment, and fight back against the wasteland itself.

Your goal is simple: survive, secure your place, and uncover what turned this world into hell.

Co-op in LAST ZONE is all about teamwork: while one player searches for supplies, another builds defenses, and a third fights off mutants. Only by working together can you transform ruins into a stronghold capable of resisting the horrors of the wasteland.

Infected zones are the richest — and the deadliest — places in the world. Face hordes of mutants with unique behaviors and abilities. Use tactics, monitor radiation levels, and always watch your corners: only those who stay alert survive here.

The countryside is the perfect place to hide. Or die.
Explore the atmosphere of abandoned villages. Supplies are scarcer here than in the cities, but so are your chances of surviving alone. Fortify an old rural house, defend yourself from mutants in the fields, and use the terrain to protect your shelter. You are the хозяин here — until night falls.

Building is your key to survival. Gather resources, construct walls and defensive structures, and turn abandoned buildings into fortified bastions capable of withstanding mutant raids and unwanted visitors.

Panel apartment blocks are grim concrete labyrinths where every apartment may hide either valuable loot or certain death. Search every floor, move carefully through stairwells, and try not to get trapped inside these endless concrete boxes.

Rivers and lakes are more than just scenery — they are a source of food. Grab a fishing rod, find a quiet spot, and catch fish before the local creatures notice you. Peaceful fishing may be the only chance to rest and fill your stomach after another harsh day in the Zone.

Do not look for easy paths. The best loot is hidden behind boarded windows and locked doors. Break your way inside to find truly valuable gear.
