Hello Operator, we've been awaiting your decision.

The Moment of Panic is an experimental strategy game set in a dystopian future, where your finger rests on the button of a weapon of unimaginable destruction.

Buried deep underground and cut off from the outside world, you must interpret incoming intelligence signals with the help of advanced AI advisors. Your only job is to decide whether to step closer to doomsday, or pull the world back from the edge.

Some signals are warnings. Some are bait. Some are accidents. Some are lies.

Your AI advisors will analyze the situation, but they are not neutral. Each one has its own worldview, strategic instincts, and hidden priorities. One may urge escalation. Another may plead for restraint. Another may sound confident for all the wrong reasons.

You make the final call.

Escalate too quickly, and you may unleash the very disaster you were trying to prevent. Hesitate too long, and you may fail to stop a real attack. Every decision pushes the crisis closer to resolution, collapse, or launch.

You do not see the war. You do not fight the enemy. You sit in the bunker and decide what the world should fear.

Features

  • Interpret short, urgent intelligence signals from an unstable future world.

  • Consult AI advisors with distinct personalities, biases, and strategic beliefs.

  • Decide whether to escalate, de-escalate, or hold your position under pressure.

  • Manage uncertainty when no source of information can be fully trusted.

  • Experience a psychological strategy game about panic, paranoia, and irreversible decisions.

  • Replay crisis scenarios where signal truth, advisor behavior, and outcomes can shift.

Innovative Storytelling Using Local AI

The Moment of Panic uses a locally running, open-source large language model constrained by game logic to create AI advisors that feel reactive, opinionated, and alive.

These are not simple dialogue trees. Your advisors can interpret the current crisis, argue with each other, justify their recommendations, and attempt to influence your decision. But beneath every conversation, the game is still tracking truth, uncertainty, pressure, and consequence.

The machines can speak. They cannot always be trusted.

store_data.about_the_game:
CRUORFALL

Two souls. One labyrinth. No mercy.

I'm building Cruorfall alone. One developer, one plan, step by step — a game I always wanted to make.

This is a roguelike dungeon crawler. Cards, dodging, runes, and a labyrinth that wants you dead. There are no difficulty sliders. There's no tutorial holding your hand. You'll die. Many times. So did I. That's the point.

THE WORLD

A gothic, ever-shifting labyrinth, rotted through with a curse of blood magic. Two strangers wake bound by fate inside it — a frail aristocrat with a sharp mind, and a brute mercenary who uses his head to hit, not to think. They have nothing in common except the dungeon. Their story unfolds slowly, in pieces. Across many deaths.

Across many runs. Across many tries.

HOW IT PLAYS

You hold cards. You play them in real time, while enemies fire at you and the floor tries to kill you. Some cards hit you with timing minigames — reflex tests, timing checks. Hit them clean and the damage spikes. Hit them perfectly, again and again, and your starter card can kill a boss. There's no ceiling. The card sets the floor. Your reflex sets the rest.

Each card also carries a single rune — a letter. Play your cards in the right order and they spell a word. The word casts a spell. Play them carelessly and the runes stay decoration.

Between turns you dodge. WASD. No pause. Read patterns, move smart, plan through the stress. Stay alive long enough to draw your next card. Don't waste the last drop of blood.

The dungeon throws riddles at you too. Reflex tests. Traps. Small puzzles. It's not just about your deck — it's about you.

PROGRESSION CUTS BOTH WAYS

You unlock crafting, enchanting, artifacts, card upgrades. None of it comes free. The same materials you spend to unlock a mechanic also pay the dungeon — enemies hit harder, enemies have more health. Every tool you earn arms them in the same breath. You don't outgrow Cruorfall. You just trade one edge for another, sharper one.

PERMADEATH

You die, you start over. The dungeon forgets. You don't.

WHY I MADE IT THIS WAY

I designed Cruorfall to be unforgiving on purpose. Not cruel — cruor (Latin for blood). The kind of game where the win means something because you earned it. The pleasure is in the bleeding.

FEATURES

  • Real-time card combat with timing-based minigames

  • Runic spellcasting through card play

  • Bullet-hell dodging during your turns

  • True permadeath — every run starts you fresh

  • Meta-progression that arms the dungeon as it arms you

  • Crafting, enchanting, artifacts, card upgrades

  • Procedural dungeons, riddles, events, traps

  • Two protagonists with a shared, slowly unfolding story (in progress)

  • Co-op and PvP — planned

  • Grim pixel art

  • Built by one developer, in the dark, slowly - somewhere in Poland

FOR PLAYERS OF

Slay the Spire. Darkest Dungeon. Anything that made you swear at your screen and come back the next night.

Bleed wisely.

store_data.about_the_game:
A dead man. A borrowed name. A case no one wants reopened.


Wild East: The Straw Man is a story-driven 2D point-and-click adventure set in the wild 1990s of Slovakia and Czechia.

Marek Varga is a young reporter at a small newsroom, sent to cover what looks like a routine death: a company director, a few suspicious papers, and another case everyone would rather forget.

But the dead man was not the person in control. He was a straw man: a name on documents, a signature where someone else needed one, and a body left behind when the scheme became inconvenient.

Together with Czech reporter Eva Svobodová, Marek follows answering-machine messages, old files, witness stories, locked doors, and uncomfortable favors through a world where the official version is rarely the true one.

Take your time. Read the room. Follow the paper trail.


This is a slower, atmospheric mystery built around conversations, observation, documents, inventory puzzles, and the strange logic of a decade where almost anything could be explained away with a stamp, a favor, or a missing file.

Features


  • Classic 2D point-and-click adventure gameplay.
  • A grounded mystery set in 1990s Slovakia and Czechia.
  • Two reporters uncovering one case from different sides of the border.
  • Dialogue-driven investigation with choices that matter.
  • Inventory puzzles, documents, witness accounts, and locked doors.
  • Dry local humor and atmospheric, slower-paced storytelling.
  • Full voice acting planned in English, Slovak, and Czech.

store_data.about_the_game:
YOU ARE THE DISPATCHER

Calls are coming in. The city needs help. You have seconds to decide.

Signal Zero puts you behind the emergency dispatch console — a one-person
operation managing police, fire, and EMS units across a city that never stops
demanding your attention.

HOW IT WORKS

  • Incidents appear on your board with a countdown timer
  • Route the right unit — send the wrong one and you'll pay for it
  • Units take time to travel — a closer unit arrives faster
  • Let calls escalate and they get harder to resolve
  • Reputation hits zero and your shift is over

BUILD YOUR DISPATCH CENTER

Earn budget on every resolved call. Spend it on additional units and upgrades
to handle more simultaneous emergencies as shifts get harder.

60 UNIQUE INCIDENTS

From bar fights to cardiac arrests to swift-water rescues — some calls are
obvious, some will trick you. A child locked in a hot car isn't a police call.
A psychiatric crisis isn't always EMS. Learn the city.

FEATURES

  • Tense single-player dispatch gameplay
  • 3 unit types — police, fire, EMS — each with unique incidents
  • Distance-based response times reward smart unit placement
  • Escalating priority system — ignore a call and it gets worse
  • Shift progression across 10 increasingly difficult shifts
  • Scanner radio atmosphere
  • Minimalist dispatch-console aesthetic

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Puzzle O’Matic, a cozy island adventure where every photo becomes a puzzle.

Explore a peaceful world full of charming places, adorable creatures, and small relaxing moments. Meet friendly NPCs, accept simple photo quests, and wander across the island looking for the perfect shot.

Take photos, create puzzles, and bring your memories to life.

When you find something special, enter Photo Mode, adjust your view, and capture the scene. Each photo is turned into a physical puzzle box that you can carry to a puzzle station, build right away, or store on shelves for later.

A relaxing loop of exploration and creativity

  • Explore a colorful island at your own pace

  • Accept quests from NPCs and discover new photo spots

  • Photograph cute animals, cozy houses, shops, flowers, and scenic places

  • Turn every photo into a jigsaw puzzle

  • Save puzzle boxes on shelves and finish them whenever you want

  • Complete puzzles to decorate the world with your finished pictures

Made for cozy players

Puzzle O’Matic is designed to be calm, gentle, and satisfying. There are no intense battles or stressful timers — just exploration, discovery, photography, and the joy of fitting pieces together.

Whether you want to finish quests, collect lovely scenes, or simply spend time in a peaceful world, Puzzle O’Matic is a small cozy journey full of cute details and handmade memories.

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

Hannibal is a grand strategy and real-time tactics game where every decision on the campaign map can turn into a decisive battlefield clash. Build your power across regions, plan your invasions, manage your army, and when war begins, take direct control of your forces in real-time battles.

In Hannibal, conquest is not only about having the largest army. Victory depends on timing, positioning, formations, and the way you use your units on the battlefield. Choose the region you want to attack, prepare your army, and enter a tactical battle where you must break the enemy line, protect your own formation, and use the terrain to your advantage.

The game combines the large-scale planning of a Grand Strategy game with the direct control and intensity of Real-Time Strategy combat. On the world map, you expand your influence, capture new lands, and decide where your next campaign will begin. On the battlefield, you command infantry, archers, cavalry, and generals in a system inspired by classic lines of battle.

Key Features

Grand Strategy Campaign

Control your nation from the campaign map. Choose which regions to attack, defend your borders, and expand your territory step by step. Every region can become an opportunity — or a dangerous trap.

Real-Time Tactical Battles

When armies meet, the battle is not decided automatically. You take command directly. Move your units, create formations, react to the enemy, and lead your army in real time.

Formation-Based Warfare

Victory depends on how well you organize your army. Infantry can hold the front line, archers can weaken enemies from a distance, cavalry can flank and break formations, and generals can change the flow of battle.

Lines of Battle Style Combat

Battles are built around frontlines, unit positioning, and tactical pressure. Breaking the enemy line at the right moment can decide the whole war.

Strategic Region Conquest

Each attack begins with a choice on the map. Decide where to strike, which army to send, and how much risk you are willing to take. A successful invasion can open the path to new territories.

Command Your Army Your Way

Use different tactics depending on the situation. Hold defensive positions, rush weak points, surround enemies, or use cavalry to attack from the sides. Your decisions matter both before and during battle.

Your Goal

store_data.detailed_description:
About This Game

Hannibal is a grand strategy and real-time tactics game where every decision on the campaign map can turn into a decisive battlefield clash. Build your power across regions, plan your invasions, manage your army, and when war begins, take direct control of your forces in real-time battles.

In Hannibal, conquest is not only about having the largest army. Victory depends on timing, positioning, formations, and the way you use your units on the battlefield. Choose the region you want to attack, prepare your army, and enter a tactical battle where you must break the enemy line, protect your own formation, and use the terrain to your advantage.

The game combines the large-scale planning of a Grand Strategy game with the direct control and intensity of Real-Time Strategy combat. On the world map, you expand your influence, capture new lands, and decide where your next campaign will begin. On the battlefield, you command infantry, archers, cavalry, and generals in a system inspired by classic lines of battle.

Key Features

Grand Strategy Campaign

Control your nation from the campaign map. Choose which regions to attack, defend your borders, and expand your territory step by step. Every region can become an opportunity — or a dangerous trap.

Real-Time Tactical Battles

When armies meet, the battle is not decided automatically. You take command directly. Move your units, create formations, react to the enemy, and lead your army in real time.

Formation-Based Warfare

Victory depends on how well you organize your army. Infantry can hold the front line, archers can weaken enemies from a distance, cavalry can flank and break formations, and generals can change the flow of battle.

Lines of Battle Style Combat

Battles are built around frontlines, unit positioning, and tactical pressure. Breaking the enemy line at the right moment can decide the whole war.

Strategic Region Conquest

Each attack begins with a choice on the map. Decide where to strike, which army to send, and how much risk you are willing to take. A successful invasion can open the path to new territories.

Command Your Army Your Way

Use different tactics depending on the situation. Hold defensive positions, rush weak points, surround enemies, or use cavalry to attack from the sides. Your decisions matter both before and during battle.

Your Goal

Your mission is to build a powerful empire through smart strategy and strong battlefield leadership. Expand your control, defeat rival forces, and prove that victory belongs not only to the strongest army, but to the best commander.

In Hannibal, every region is a decision.

Every battle is a test.

Every victory brings you closer to domination.

Build formations, break enemy lines, and lead your empire to victory through smart strategy and battlefield decisions.

store_data.about_the_game:
HELLOCRACY

Welcome to hell.

Take a ticket and wait to be called.

HELLOCRACY is a short, story-driven first-person survival shooter about a man who, after death, finds himself in a bureaucratic hell. Here, demons wear ties, the offices never end, and every new corridor smells of stale coffee and burnt-out employees.

The player must survive among endless departments, search for resources, craft items, read notes from fallen hellish workers, and try to figure out if escape is even possible.

The combat system is built around limited resources and aggressive enemies.

  • First-person shooting

  • Pistol with two firing modes

  • Dash for dodging

  • Fast enemies and long-range combat

Traps and resource management:

  • LMB - single shot;

  • RMB - empty entire magazine at once

Sometimes it's better to conserve ammo; sometimes it's too late.

To survive, you'll need to gather resources and use your inventory.

The player can:

  • Create bandages

  • Use buffs

  • Restore health

  • Increase damage

  • Temporarily increase stamina with coffee

Every item found can be useful later in the level.

Hell here operates like a huge, broken system.

The levels contain:

  • Traps

  • Toxic zones

  • Closed office sections

  • Loudspeakers with employee announcements

  • Lore through posters and notes

The story is told through the environment and comic inserts instead of cutscenes.

Enemies

Clerk

A typical office worker from hell.

Attacks from close range and constantly presses.

Toxic

A heavy ranged enemy that attacks with toxic projectiles.

The Little

A fast and dangerous enemy that dies easily, but is excellent at finishing off inattentive players.

Shredder - General Manager

The final boss and ruler of this section of Hell. A huge monster that attacks in melee combat and releases smaller mobs during battle.

Control

  • LMB — shoot

  • RMB — fire all bullets

  • F — close-range attack with suitcase

  • G — throw grenade

  • Shift — run

  • Space — dash

  • B / I — inventory

  • ESC — pause

  • 1 / 2 / 3 — quick item slots

About the project

Made with Unreal Engine 5

The game is designed to last approximately 10-15 minutes and is a short story-driven adventure with elements of survival and first-person shooter.

Tomboy is a sci-fi survival game with minimalistic gameplay and rogue-lite elements.

Humanity is gone. The biomechanical colonies have fallen and there’s nowhere left to run. Fight through endless swarms, survive until extraction, and become stronger with every run. Collect scraps and experiment with devastating builds. The sci-fi indie chaos that lets you make bullet heaven real.

• Experiment with different synergies and evolve your build into a destruction machine.

store_data.about_the_game:
Rogue Jet Fighter is a fast‑paced arcade space shooter that sends you on a dangerous solo mission deep inside hostile alien territory. Your objective: reach and destroy the enemy’s Death Moon station — a colossal super‑weapon capable of wiping out entire fleets. Armed with your jet fighter, quick reflexes, and a single powerful blaster bomb, you must fight your way through waves of alien ships, deadly obstacles, and chaotic space environments.

Fly through asteroid fields, dodge incoming fire, and blast enemy fighters in classic arcade‑style combat. Choose from multiple ships and space scenes, each offering a different visual and more challenging experience. Tight controls and fast action make every run intense, challenging, and replayable.

Your mission is simple: survive long enough to get close to the Death Moon station… and blow it apart.

Features

  • Fast, arcade‑style space shooting with intense enemy waves

  • Solo mission behind enemy lines with a clear objective: destroy the Death Moon station

  • Dodge asteroids and enemy fire in high‑speed combat

  • Use your powerful blaster bomb when you reach the station

  • Multiple ships and space scenes to choose from

  • Colorful 3D environments with classic sci‑fi style

  • Simple, responsive controls designed for quick action

  • Short, replayable runs perfect for arcade shooter fans

store_data.about_the_game:
From a garage to a global empire

You started with a laptop and an idea. Idle Startup is a relaxing incremental game about growing that idea into a tech company — one completed task at a time.

Pick a skill, and it goes to work. Progress bars fill, XP rolls in, money stacks up. Spend it on upgrades, level up, and watch new skills and whole departments unlock as your company grows.

Every skill is its own journey

Each of the six skills has its own upgrade store — a tree of nine upgrades gated by skill level and cost. Most boost that skill alone, but every skill hits milestones at levels 25, 50, 75 and 99 that reward a permanent, company-wide bonus. There's always a reason to push one more level.

Simple to start, deep to grow

The whole game makes sense in under a minute — select a skill, earn, upgrade, repeat. But there's always a next unlock: a costlier upgrade, a milestone, a new department, the next achievement. Max a skill out and it keeps earning Mastery, a slow bonus that never stops growing.

Always progressing

Idle Startup respects your time. The game keeps earning while it's closed (up to 4 hours), and a free Coffee Break speed boost is yours to claim a few times a day. Your save syncs through Steam Cloud, so you can pick up on any device.

Optional boost packs (you don't need them)

Three small optional purchases let you skip ahead if you want to: an Energy Drink for a 2× speed boost across four hours, a Coffee Pot for a full 24 hours, and a one-time Productivity Suite for a permanent 2× speed boost and unlimited offline earnings. None of them are required — the whole game is playable and completable without spending anything.

Features

  • One-click idle loop — pick a skill, it runs itself

  • 6 skills across 4 company tiers, from Garage Startup to Corporate Office

  • Per-skill upgrade trees plus a company-wide store — 66 upgrades in all

  • Milestone upgrades at Lv 25/50/75/99 that buff your whole company

  • Skill Mastery — maxed skills keep earning a permanent money bonus

  • 29 Steam achievements, from First Day to Trillionaire

  • Two interface themes — sleek Midnight, or warm Poolside FM sunset

  • Offline progress — earn while you're away

  • Steam Cloud saves — play on Windows and macOS (Steam Deck supported via Proton)

  • A free recurring speed boost, no ads ever

  • Optional one-time boost purchases — never required, never gated

  • Clean, modern interface designed to stay out of your way

quests. Rotating weekly events keep the world alive and rewarding.

Fair play enforced.

Welcome to Stepwell Step into a microscopic dimension where up and down are merely suggestions. In Stepwell, you are the architect of impossible structures. You are tasked with building pathways for your Quarks—quirky, geometric creatures driven by a singular goal: harvesting energy-rich Joules.

store_data.about_the_game:
【Synopsis】

100,000 Trees to Go is a relaxing logging sim about building a one-axe operation into something that can clear an entire forest. Every tree on the map is real. Every one falls.

【Gameplay: Logging Operation Simulator】

  • Chop grab an axe and get started. Every tree has physics, every hit counts, every stump stays.

  • Hire workers each one has their own stats — speed, stamina, carry capacity. Put the right person in the right zone and the operation moves. Put the wrong one anywhere and you'll feel it.

  • Deploy bots automated collectors that run routes while you focus elsewhere. Set them up, optimize later.

  • Find gear in the field better axes and tools drop as you explore. One good find can change how fast the whole operation runs.

  • Build your camp zone by zone, your base grows alongside the crew.

  • Unlock new zones denser forest, different terrain, better prices. The map opens up as the counter goes down.

【Key Features】

  • 100,000 individual trees — every single one is on the map and every single one can be chopped

  • Real worker stats — speed, stamina, carry capacity matter; wrong hire, wrong zone, you'll notice

  • Bot automation — set up collection routes and let them run

  • Field gear drops — equipment found while exploring can shift your whole strategy

  • Open map progression — unlock zones, expand camp, watch the number drop faster

  • Challenges: Milestone objectives that mark your progress — from hiring your first worker to becoming a legitimate terror of the woods.

Just the forest, an axe, and 100,000 trees to go.

store_data.about_the_game:
Ornament Tower is an action-adventure & puzzle game for up to two players. The couple of explorers Azulin and Guaraná were climbing the dangerous canyons that surround the abandoned Ornament Tower when they fell and woke up in its vicinity. Because they got too close to the tower, they were cursed and their bodies transformed into those of animals.

Created by Lotovik, former Lead Pixel Artist of Fields of Mistria.

Explore over 120 floors across 5 distinct towers, each with different environments full of challenges, monsters, and puzzles.

Get ready for this adventure playing with one or two players. Cooperation is the key to reaching the top of the tower… and also to each other's hearts.

Defeat monsters together using elements of the environment, or use them to your advantage to solve puzzles!

Rack your brain solving puzzles involving boxes, keys, gates, time, thorns, and all sorts of dangers!

Help Azulin and Guaraná recover their original bodies by collecting the strange and mysterious spheres of living matter…

store_data.about_the_game:
Killing Slime is a roguelite tower defense game where time, strategy, and strange allies collide.

Build your defense on a grid, draft new units from the shop, and survive wave after wave of enemies pouring through unstable portals. Every run starts small, but each cleared wave gives you more gold, more choices, and more ways to turn your board into a ridiculous engine of destruction.

Recruit an unpredictable roster of units from across eras and genres: archers, minotaurs, foot troopers, laser soldiers, wizards, unicorns, mechs, orbital lasers, and more. Place them carefully, combine their strengths, and adapt as enemies grow faster, tougher, and more numerous.

Between combat cycles, choose powerful augments that reshape your strategy for the rest of the run. Temporary round modifiers keep each cycle dangerous, forcing you to rethink your setup when enemies speed up, towers slow down, interest disappears, or the rules bend against you.

Features

  • Grid-based tower defense with wave survival

  • A shop-driven unit drafting system with rerolls and rarity odds

  • Unlockable units across fantasy, modern, prehistoric, mystic, and futuristic themes

  • Roguelite augments that stack into powerful builds

  • Temporary round modifiers that change the rules every few waves

  • Gold economy with income, interest, and strategic spending

  • Escalating enemy waves, limited lives, and run-based progression

Defend the gate. Draft the weirdest army possible. Survive long enough to see what breaks first: the enemies, the timeline, or your build.

store_data.about_the_game:
Is it a place you live in… or a rule you obey to survive?

After 9:59 is a short (~30-minutes) indie horror walking simulator with a simple, clear story and uncluttered gameplay.

You play as Clara, moving into a new apartment building. Before leaving, the landlord gives you a list of strange rules. Most seem unusual. But one stands out above all the others: “Do not open your door after 9:59 PM.”

Clara, who used to live in a village. After a painful accident, she decides to start a new life, so she moves to the city and begins living in an apartment building.

Rules You Must Follow:

  • Do not open your door after 9:59 PM.

    No matter who is knocking.

  • Do not respond to voices from the hallway.

    Even if they sound familiar.

  • Do not look through the peephole after 9:59 PM.

    Some things are better left unseen.

  • If someone claims to be the landlord, stay inside.

    The landlord never returns at night.

Designed to be played in one sitting (~30 minutes), with a tense atmosphere.

Game Features:

  • Atmospheric indie horror experience

  • Immersive, tense sound design

  • Simple, story-driven walking gameplay

  • Short and focused (~30 minutes) experience

  • Minimalist gameplay with psychological tension

store_data.about_the_game:
You begin the descent again... How many times have you attempted to reach the bottom? 20 floors... only 20 floors.

You lost your life years ago, but instead of entering the afterlife, you were forced into a dungeon of endless horrors. Under the watchful eye of The Voice and The Masters, the torment will not end until you reach the bottom. Every brutal death is remembered. The dungeon is always changing. The torment never stops.

20 Floors Down is a top-down horror roguelite where survival depends on resource management, careful exploration, and the weapons you carry into the dark. The dungeons are unforgiving, the monsters are relentless, and the only light you have is the one in your hand; and you DO NOT want to let that light run out.

Features:

  • Procedurally generated floors that grow larger and more dangerous as you descend.

  • Full controller and keyboard/mouse support

  • Beat the game and unlock an unlimited mode that let's you go as deep as your skill allows.

  • A cast of horrifying enemies including giant spiders, skeleton armies, and many more. Each enemy has a unique AI that challenges you differently.

  • Dungeon crawling roguelike system. Items exponentially increase in value as you delve deeper.

  • A deep inventory, upgrade, and loadout system. Choose your weapons and items wisely before each descent.

  • A unique dynamic lighting system that enemies will use against you.

  • A dark, evolving narrative told through notes that you left on previous descents.

Shape the Dungeon:
With full Steam Workshop integration and a robust modding API, you can alter the dungeon yourself. Code new items, design custom enemies, or download community-made creations to completely change your descent.

The Voice says reaching the bottom will end the suffering. But what awaits you at the bottom?

What awaits you 20 floors down?

store_data.about_the_game:
Mine into the depths of mount Olympus.

Echoes of the Deep is an incremental endless idle game where you mine rocks, collect rare Lefkadium crystals, and unlock powerful upgrades to grow your production.

DEEP DESCENT

You can sacrifice your progress to descend deeper into the mountain. Each descent permanently multiplies your Rock and Lefkadium gains. Stack your multipliers across dozens of descents and see your numbers climb!

ORE VEINS

Unlock 16 tiers of Ore Veins through an expansive upgrade tree with over 300 nodes. Each tier boosts your production , from humble beginnings to numbers that need scientific notation to display.

ECHOES

After each Deep Descent, choose a powerful Echo that shapes your run. Echoes can transform your run from good to Legendary and no two runs feel quite the same. Chase Legendary Echoes for the biggest rewards.

MILESTONES / ACHIEVMENTS

Over 200 milestones that tracks everything you do . Blocks mined, peaks destroyed, descents completed, time played, and more.

QUESTS

Daily and weekly quests give you permanent bonuses that accumulate over time. The longer you play, the stronger your endgame becomes.

ROCK TREE

Spend your Rock to unlock a spiral of 24 permanent nodes that multiply your income, boost your Anomalies, and make every block count.

ROCK RARITIES

Unlock 4 ore rarities that provide extra multipliers and bonuses. Their glow is very profitable.

THE DRILL

Constantine channels his inner strength and conjures a massive Drill in front of him . Mining huge amount of rocks and other resources . Upgrade it through its own talent tree.

THE RESONANCE FIELD

A curved energy field that extends from your drill tip and boosts every block and peak it touches. Upgrade it through its own talent tree.

PATH OF OLYMPUS

The mountain has a name. It is Mount Olympus. The Path of Olympus reveals the journey ahead where you are now and where you are going. with more locations to be added.

OFFLINE PROGRESS

Your miner keeps running while you're away. Come back to a full haul ready to spend .

ANOMALIES

Two rare Anomaly types can appear in the world at any time.

Anomaly: Lefkadium : teleports you to a 25-second farming burst.

Anomaly: Vein Extraction : puts your Ore Vein branches against each other , the winning branch gets buffed for 25 minutes.

Chain them for massive gains.

THE DARK MARKET

Mine a black rock and meet the Dark Wanderer. Choose one powerful buff from a pool of 100.

Simple to pick up. Impossible to put down.

Disclaimer : 
AI tools where not used during development of the game

Visual assets, music, and sprites werecreated by artists and licensed musicians.

All of the above are also listed in the credits of the game .

Thank you

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Green Market, a cozy dispensary management simulator set in a charming low‑poly voxel world.

You’re the proud owner of a small shop with big dreams. Customers walk through your door with specific needs – exact strains, exact weights. It’s up to you to keep your shelves stocked, your scales calibrated, and your register ringing. Every sale you complete adds money to your pocket, which you can reinvest into your business to make it grow.

How It Works

Order fresh product from the wholesale market using your shop laptop. After a short delivery time, wooden pallets appear outside your door, loaded with jars of premium flower. Carry the jars inside, place them on your shelves, and get ready for business.

Customers arrive, form a line, and place orders. They want a specific strain and a specific weight—no substitutions, no “close enough.” Use the scale to weigh out the exact amount, bag it up, and complete the sale at the register. Happy customers leave you with a tip, and your reputation grows. Frustrated customers walk out, and you lose the sale.

Build Your Dream Dispensary

As you earn money, you can unlock new strains, upgrade your storage shelves to hold more jars, increase your queue capacity to serve more customers, and boost your marketing to bring in foot traffic faster. You can also improve your delivery speed and pallet capacity so you always have the product you need on hand.

Your shop is your canvas. Decorate with glowing neon signs, potted plants, and cozy couches. Every decoration adds a permanent tip multiplier, so making your dispensary feel like home pays off.

Realistic, Relaxed, Rewarding

Green Market is a single‑player experience with no time pressure, no fail‑state, and no stress. You control the pace. It’s a game about attention to detail, efficiency, and the satisfaction of watching your small shop turn into a thriving business.

Key Features

  • Authentic Dispensary Management – Greet customers, fill precise orders, and run every detail of your shop.

  • Physical Order Fulfillment – Weigh product on a working scale, bag it up, and complete the sale at the register.

  • Wholesale Delivery System – Buy product online and wait for it to arrive on pallets outside. Carry jars inside and place them wherever you like.

  • Dynamic Customer Queue – Customers line up with unique requests. A visible patience bar tells you exactly how much time you have.

  • Deep Progression – Unlock new strains, upgrade shelves, queue capacity, marketing, pallets, and delivery speed.

  • Decorations That Matter – Neon signs, plants, and couches boost your tip multiplier, encouraging you to make your shop your own.

  • Full Save System – Three save slots, persistent world state, and even the jar you’re carrying is saved.

  • No Pressure – Play at your own pace. No timers, no fail‑states, just the joy of building a business.

So grab your keys, unlock the door, and welcome to Green Market – where every gram counts.

store_data.about_the_game:
you are the operator of a system that is learning to run itself.

it starts small: you click, you build, you watch a number climb. then you automate the clicking. then you automate the thing that automates the clicking. layer by layer the machine takes over - and one by one, your own controls deactivate. the buttons go dark not because you failed, but because you succeeded. you are automating yourself out of a job, and the job is you.

when the machine finally no longer needs you, there is one control left.

BREAK THE CYCLE.

you wake up one layer higher. doing it again. faster, this time, because you remember - and so, quietly, does the machine.

cold terminal calm.

the whole game is a monochrome-green console with the hum of a system running itself. lowercase prose, no carnival, no nags, no dark-pattern timers. the ui is the machine.

an idle game that respects your time.

meaningful offline progress, instant readability, honest math. leave it running for days or sit with it for an hour - both are intended.

depth that compounds.

a branching tree of upgrades each run, ten workers who grow a second skill as you go, and a small web of echo choices that bend every repeat. achievements double as a checklist of everything to see.

a loop that knows it's a loop.

the narration remembers. each cycle it gets a little more knowing. there is something on the other side of enough repetitions - not a door out, but a thing to understand. we won't say more than that.

built for the people who finished universal paperclips and wanted the feeling again.

You cannot see four dimensions. But you can see what a four-dimensional object looks like from inside three-dimensional space.

A 4D chess piece passing through your world doesn't appear all at once. You see a cross-section of it — a slice. Depending on where along the fourth axis the slice falls, the same piece can appear small, regular, or large. Move along the fourth dimension and the cross-section changes. The piece shifts. Its apparent form in your space is not its true form. It is a shadow of something bigger.

That is Vektor Chess.

The board extends across three spatial dimensions — eight files, eight ranks, eight layers deep. Pieces move through all of it: rooks sweep full columns, bishops cut diagonally through the stack, pawns climb upward layer by layer. But the board is not the whole picture. Every piece also exists along a fourth axis, invisible to you, expressing itself in three-dimensional space as a phase — Small, Regular, or Large.

Phase is not a status effect. It is geometry. It is the piece's true position rendered in a dimension you can only glimpse.

To capture, you must meet the piece where it actually is — not just in space, but in state. Position is necessary. Phase is also necessary. A piece can stand directly beside its enemy and remain completely harmless, because in the fourth dimension, they are not in the same place at all.

store_data.about_the_game:
Altarnode is a dark 2D top-down survival colony-defense roguelite where you play as an evil god protecting a desperate cult from endless waves of critters. Offer sacrifices through the Altar Node, expand your colony, and survive as long as your followers can sustain its growing ritual demand.

Keep Feeding the Altar

Kill roaming critters, let your cultists process their bodies into meat, and offer sacrifices at the Altar to keep your cult alive.

Build and Expand

Place new Nodes including pits, butcheries, storage, and defensive structures. Placement matters, efficient layouts improve logistics, while strong defensive positioning can decide how long your colony survives.

Your Divine Power

Strike enemies with mouse-driven attacks while your cultists focus on their ritual work. Every sacrifice empowers the altar and grants you greater divine strength.

Survive

Critters grow more dangerous over time while the altar demands larger and larger offerings. The moment sacrifices stop, the countdown start and Altar collapse begins.

Unlock Upgrades and Power

Earn Tithe at the end of each run based on total meat sacrificed. Spend it to unlock upgrades, improve efficiency, strengthen future starts, and discover new ways to survive longer.

Altarnode is a fast, replayable roguelite about momentum, pressure, and sacrifice. Build carefully, feed the altar, and push your cult a little further with every run.

4781900.name: Bust a Nut! A Game About Raising Cocks

store_data.about_the_game:
Bust a Nut! A Game About Raising Cocks

Inheriting your late uncle's estate, The Nut House, wasn't exactly what you had planned for your weekend... but it's time to roll up your sleeves and get to work. Do you have the stamina to handle the world's fifth-largest nut empire?

Grab Your Nuts and Get Pulling!

Start from the bottom and work your way up. Use your own two hands to Bust a Nut! manually, or hire a massive flock of Cocks and other trusty farm animals to handle the heavy stroking for you. The more you pump into your farm, the bigger your yield becomes!

Experience Massive Growth Spurts

  • The Nut Tree: Climb the branch of success! Spend your nuts on the Nut Tree to unlock permanent perks that keep your wood hard and your production flowing.

  • Deep Prestige: When your bush is tapped out, it's time to release! Reset your progress to spread your Seed. Use those Seed Points to ensure your next growth spurt is even harder and faster.

  • The Blue Ball Bonus: Keep an eye out for a sudden Blue Ball... clicking it gives you a temporary, throbbing seed bonus that really hits the spot.

Play the Market with Your Nut Sack

Is your Nut Sack feeling heavy? Take it to Wall-Nut Street!

  • Invest in blue-chip giants like Deez & Co.

  • Short or long your positions to earn Gacha Tokens. Just make sure you don't get caught with an empty sack when the market goes limp!

The Nut Grab & The Creature Arena

Ready for some furry fun? Reach into the Nut Grab to spend your hard-earned nuts on a new companion. You might pull out a Dirty Pussy, a Smelly Beaver, or even a Big Ass.

  • Train Your Unit: Every creature comes with four signature moves, like Small Squeeze, Heavy Pant, or Huge Load.

  • The Nut Cracker: Take your prize Cock to the arena and beat off the competition! Defeat the four legendary trainers to earn the ultimate prize: a Pearl Necklace for your sweetheart.

A Twist You Won't See Coming!

Travel the land to defeat the four elite Gym Leaders:

  • Ben Dover

  • Phil McCracken

  • Mike Oxmal

  • Anita Hanjaub



Bust a Nut! is a game of girth, grit, and high-frequency friction.

Wishlist now... it's going to be a long night in the barn!
